title: Business Operations & Team Support Manager
description:
Operations Manager / Right-Hand Support for Growing Service Business

Team Support | Operations | Communication | Implementation



We are looking for a highly capable, proactive, and dependable Operations Manager / Right-Hand Support person to help support a growing service business.



This is not just an assistant role. This is a high-level support role for someone who can help keep the business organized, moving, and growing. We need someone who can support the owner closely, help manage moving parts, support the team, improve systems, and help turn ideas into real execution.



The right person will be proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and strong with follow-through. They should be able to listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions to fully understand what is needed, and then carry things out accurately and efficiently.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, helping manage people and priorities, and turning ideas into action.



About the role



We are looking for someone who can act as a strong right-hand support person inside the business.



This person will help with operations, team coordination, communication, implementation, and general business support. They will help keep the owner out of every small detail by taking ideas, understanding the vision, and helping move things forward in an organized and thoughtful way.



This role requires someone who can balance:

 • listening carefully to direction

 • asking smart clarifying questions

 • taking initiative

 • following through

 • helping manage people and moving parts

 • improving systems as the business grows



Responsibilities may include:

 • Supporting day-to-day business operations

 • Helping manage team communication, follow-up, and accountability

 • Keeping projects, tasks, and moving parts organized

 • Helping turn ideas into real plans, systems, and completed actions

 • Assisting with process improvement and operational organization

 • Supporting client communication in a professional and friendly way

 • Supporting referral partner communication and follow-up

 • Helping manage backend administrative tasks

 • Keeping the owner informed while also helping reduce overwhelm

 • Helping ensure things do not get dropped as the business grows

 • Supporting team coordination and helping people stay on track

 • Helping create more structure, consistency, and follow-through in the business



We are especially looking for someone who:

 • Has experience supporting a small, growing service business

 • Understands how to work in a hands-on, fast-moving environment

 • Can help manage a team and keep people accountable

 • Is proactive, but does not make careless assumptions

 • Listens carefully and follows direction well

 • Asks thoughtful questions to understand what is wanted before moving forward

 • Can take ideas from the owner and help turn them into reality

 • Is strong at execution, organization, and follow-through

 • Is professional, personable, calm, and dependable

 • Is good with both people and operational details



The right person for this role is:

 • A strong listener

 • Detail-oriented

 • Organized

 • Proactive

 • Solutions-oriented

 • Friendly and professional

 • Good at communication

 • Good at managing moving parts

 • Comfortable helping manage others

 • Thoughtful, coachable, and dependable

 • Able to bridge the gap between ideas and execution



This is a good fit if you:

 • Enjoy helping a business owner stay organized and supported

 • Like bringing order to fast-moving situations

 • Are strong at follow-up and implementation

 • Can listen to a vision and help make it real

 • Are comfortable helping manage a team

 • Want a meaningful long-term role inside a growing company

 • Take pride in being dependable, thoughtful, and strong in execution



Important note



We are looking for someone who can listen intently, understand direction clearly, and execute accurately. We value initiative, but we also value someone who takes the time to understand the goal before acting.



This role is for someone who can help take what is in the owner’s head and help organize, implement, and move it into real life.

title: AI Implementation Specialist
description:
About Tara Zaluski (
)

Tara Zaluski is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (USA) real estate investing business built and run under Tara's own personal brand at 
. We buy and renovate flips, hold a growing portfolio of multi-unit rental properties, and are actively pursuing the acquisition of an established trade business (HVAC) from a retiring owner. We run lean, and we believe AI should be doing far more of the repetitive, systems-level work across our business than it currently is.



The Opportunity

We're hiring a part-time, fully remote AI Implementation Specialist to find and build the AI-driven systems our business needs, across marketing, sales follow-up, bookkeeping, property management, and day-to-day operations, without waiting to be told what to build. You will be given context about how the business runs, and it will be on you to identify where AI and automation can save time and money, propose it, and implement it. This is not a task-execution role; it's an ownership role.



If you need a detailed brief before you can act, or you wait for direction on what to build next, this is not the right role for you. If you naturally notice inefficiency and can't help but go build a fix for it, it is.



What You'll Do

• Scout and implement. Continuously identify new AI tools, agents, and workflows relevant to a real estate investing business, and bring working solutions, not just suggestions.

• Lead generation & cold calling. Build and manage AI-assisted cold calling, texting, and lead follow-up systems that integrate with our 



CRM (Follow Up Boss).

• Social media & marketing. Stand up AI-supported content creation, scheduling, and posting systems for our social platforms under our personal brand.

• Bookkeeping & bill pay. Implement AI/automation for expense categorization, invoice handling, and bill-pay workflows, working alongside our bookkeeper rather than replacing her judgment.

• Property management support. Build AI tools for tenant communication, maintenance triage, and reporting that make our property manager's job faster.

• Deal evaluation. Support AI-assisted analysis for flip deals (targeting ~$100k profit), multi-unit acquisitions, and due diligence on a trade-company (HVAC) acquisition.

• Systems & documentation. Document every workflow you build in clear SOPs so the team can use and maintain it without you.

• Team enablement. Train and support existing team members (VA, bookkeeper, transaction coordinator, property manager) on new AI tools as you roll them out.

• Reporting. Track and report the time, cost, or error savings each implementation produces.



What We're Looking For

• A track record of actually building AI/automation solutions in a business, not just using ChatGPT casually. You should be able to show us 2–3 concrete examples.

• Strong self-direction, comfortable identifying opportunities and acting on them with minimal oversight.

• Working knowledge of automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n), AI agent/GPT builders, and prompting for business use cases.

• Comfortable learning CRM (Follow Up Boss), bookkeeping (Buildium), and social scheduling tools well enough to automate around them.

• Excellent written English — this role is fully async and remote, so clear written communication matters as much as technical skill.

• Based in the Philippines, able to overlap for live check-ins with a U.S. Eastern Time business.



Nice to Have

• Experience in or with U.S. real estate investing, property management, or a related trade/services business.

• Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or multi-step automations end-to-end.

• Background in cold-calling/lead-gen or digital marketing automation specifically.



How to Apply Send: 

(1) your resume,

(2) 2–3 specific examples of AI tools, agents, or automations you've built and the result they produced, and 

(3) a short note (200 words or less) describing one AI opportunity you'd tackle first if hired and why. 

Applications without concrete examples will not be considered.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.

title: Event Sales & Business Development Assistant
description:
ABOUT SIGNIFICANT AFFAIR

Significant Affair is a wedding and event planning, design, coordination, and event services company serving Central Florida and beyond.



We specialize in weddings, quinceañeras, Sweet 16s, birthdays, corporate events, fairs & festivals, multicultural celebrations, and more.



Our services include event planning and coordination, event design, décor, florals, rentals, custom installations, 360° photo booths, uplighting, dancing on the clouds, projections, catering, bar services, and entertainment.



We are looking for a proactive, organized, motivated, and sales-minded VA who can help generate clients, build venue and business relationships, manage leads, and support daily operations.



This is more than an administrative role. We want someone who actively looks for opportunities, builds connections, follows up, and helps turn opportunities into booked events.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Client Acquisition & Lead Management

- Find potential wedding and event clients actively seeking our services.

- Post services on appropriate platforms and monitor
 groups, wedding communities, portals, and other lead sources.

- Respond to approved inquiries and follow up with leads and past prospects.

- Schedule discovery calls and consultations for Jasmin.

- Maintain the CRM, client portal, and lead tracker.

- Track leads from inquiry through consultation, proposal, booking, or lost lead.

- Send approved packets, questionnaires, and follow-ups.

- Ensure qualified leads are properly tracked and followed up.



2. Venue Relationships

- Research wedding and event venues throughout Central Florida.

- Identify venue managers and appropriate contacts.

- Introduce Significant Affair and schedule meetings for Jasmin.

- Research preferred/approved vendor programs and requirements.

- Identify opportunities to become a preferred vendor.

- Maintain the venue database and track partnership opportunities.



3. Business Development

- Research corporate event opportunities, bridal shows, expos, networking events, and industry opportunities.

- Identify referral and partnership opportunities.

- Research hotels, venues, photographers, caterers, DJs, florists, bridal boutiques, and other event professionals.

- Help develop a preferred vendor and referral network.

- Research new platforms and opportunities for promoting Significant Affair.



4. Client & Event Support

- Send questionnaires, forms, contracts, and approved reminders.

- Organize client folders and documentation.

- Track deposits, payments, deadlines, and unpaid invoices.

- Assist with timelines, vendor contact sheets, setup/teardown checklists, and event-day documents.

- Confirm final details with vendors before events.

- Track RSVPs when applicable.

- Send final documents to vendors and venues 2 weeks before each event.



5. Marketing & Social Media

- Schedule approved social media content.

- Organize and repurpose event photos/videos.

- Create simple Canva graphics using company branding.

- Post approved services and rental inventory.

- Assist with promoting packages and services.

- Research marketing opportunities.

- Request client testimonials and reviews using approved messaging.



6. Support for Jasmin

- Manage consultations, meetings, appointments, and calendar organization.

- Prepare research and information for meetings.

- Follow up after meetings.

- Keep CRM, lead, and business-development records updated.

- Provide a weekly report covering leads, follow-ups, consultations, venue contacts, and business opportunities.



COMPENSATION

Hourly Pay

$6 USD/hour — 20 hours per week (4 days × 5 hours)



Commission

Earn 2% commission on eligible Significant Affair service revenue from new clients you directly generate.



Examples:

$3,000 booking → $60

$5,000 booking → $100

$8,000 booking → $160

$10,000 booking → $200



VA-Generated Lead Requirements

A lead qualifies when the VA:



- Personally identifies the opportunity.

- Initiates / facilitates the initial connection.

- Documents the lead in the lead tracker.

- Helps move the lead to a consultation.

- The client signs a contract and pays Significant Affair.



Commission is paid only after the event is successfully completed and there is no cancellation, refund, or qualifying adjustment.

Commission applies only to eligible Significant Affair service revenue and does not include third-party/vendor costs or rental revenue.



Preferred Vendor Exception

Bookings resulting from Significant Affair being listed, recommended, approved, or designated as a preferred vendor by a venue or organization are not commissionable, even if the VA helped establish the relationship.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 



- Proactive, self-motivated, and dependable

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients and businesses

- Strong online research and professional outreach skills

- Sales-minded without being pushy

- Able to work independently

- Creative, resourceful, and eager to learn



Experience is a plus in:

Virtual assistance, sales, lead generation, business development, customer service, event/wedding planning, hospitality, appointment setting, social media, Canva, or CRM systems.



INITIATIVE IS ESSENTIAL

We don't want someone who waits for instructions for every task.



We want someone who can say:



"I found an opportunity. Here's what I found, here's what I recommend, and here's what I think we should do next." 

"I have an Idea to move the business to the next level"



You'll receive training, direction, and the tools you need, but we expect you to eventually work independently and actively contribute to the growth of Significant Affair. 



We Grow & You Will Grow Too!

title: Video Editor For Dental Videos on YouTube
description:
I have 3 YouTube channels, and I need a new editor who uses DaVinci Resolve. I use a cloud-based team editing approach, which means you will need to learn to edit from proxy files and have the storage space to do it. I do about 3 videos a month. Each video pays $100 for videos under 15 minutes, and I offer up to $150 for longer videos; each video can also earn a bonus. Videos are usually about 7 to 14 minutes long.



REQUIREMENTS

1. YOU MUST USE DAVINCI RESOLVE and have a license to edit from the cloud. (You can use free version for trial but need full version after)

2. After the paid trial, you will need 1.3 TB of AVAILABLE STORAGE SPACE for all the proxies.

3. You must deliver videos on time. 



BONUS: 

I also offer bonuses for videos that don't require much follow-up editing and are done on time. For example, if the video pay is $100 and I don't need many revisions, I offer a $30 bonus, for a total of $130 per video. 



TEAM EDITING PROCESS

My projects are based on team editing, so I can make edits and notes myself. So the process is probably different from what you're used to.



My process involves: 1- Downloading the proxies from my server. 2- Chopping up the A-roll. 3- Adding B-roll. 4- Adding graphics, text, Titles, Transitions, and Music. 5- Changing the revisions that I send.



THE KIND OF VIDEOS & PROJECTS: 

The current channel for this job listing is called Baseline Dental on YouTube; you should watch some of the videos already done on that channel. Once you have my process down and edit well, I have 2 other channels, and I will give you more projects for them to earn more. You can expect to make $350 to $400 per month at first, doing 3 videos a month. If you edit fast and on time, I will move you on to other projects, shorts, and possibly other channels. Then you can expect to make about $400 to $600 or possibly more.



Each video will take about 6 to 8 hours once you are used to the process. It may take longer at first. 



My other channels are called The Proposal and Brielle Buck. However, at first we will just be working with the Baseline Dental channel.



PAID TRIAL:

This paid trial and process will take a few days to learn and set up. But after that, everything will get easier.



I have current editors who have been working for me for 5 years. I have been on YouTube for over 8 years. So this can be a reliable long-term job for you. I hope you will be my next editor!



Please apply and respond if you have used DaVinci and can deliver videos reliably and on time. Talk to you soon!

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper – QuickBooks Online
description:
We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Part-Time Bookkeeper to join our team and support the bookkeeping and accounting needs of U.S.-based businesses.



This is not simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping and accounting principles, can accurately determine how transactions should be classified, understands how a Chart of Accounts works, and knows when something does not look correct.



The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for tasks including:



Maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online

Reviewing and categorizing bank and credit card transactions

Understanding and correctly applying the client's Chart of Accounts

Identifying transactions that may be incorrectly classified

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Reviewing accounts for duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly recorded transactions

Accounts payable and accounts receivable support

Understanding and processing payroll

Reviewing payroll reports and payroll-related transactions

Recording payroll entries correctly in QuickBooks

Assisting with month-end bookkeeping and account review

Preparing and reviewing basic financial reports, including:

Profit & Loss

Balance Sheet

General Ledger

Accounts Receivable

Accounts Payable

Maintaining organized financial documentation and supporting records

Communicating questions, discrepancies, or missing information clearly to our team

Following up on unresolved bookkeeping items instead of leaving them incomplete

Required Qualifications



You should have:



Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

A solid understanding of bookkeeping and basic accounting principles

Strong understanding of Charts of Accounts

Experience accurately categorizing and classifying transactions

Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations

Experience with payroll and an understanding of how payroll affects the books

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred

Strong attention to detail

Ability to identify when financial information does not make sense

Ability to research an issue before asking for assistance

Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines

Strong written English communication skills

Ability to communicate questions clearly and provide enough information for someone else to understand the issue

Technology Skills



Our team primarily works within the Microsoft ecosystem. You should be comfortable using:



Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word

Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint

PDF documents and PDF editing/organization tools



Strong Excel skills are important. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, sorting and filtering information, using formulas, and reviewing financial data.



Schedule



This is a 20-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday.



You must be able to work during U.S. Central Time.



We are flexible regarding the exact schedule. An earlier Central Time schedule or a later afternoon Central Time schedule can both work. We care more about establishing a consistent schedule, meeting deadlines, and being available to communicate with our team when necessary.



The schedule can be discussed and finalized with the selected candidate.



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



Candidates with significant U.S. bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, and payroll experience may qualify toward the higher end of the range.



There is an opportunity for increased compensation and transition to a full-time position based on performance, reliability, accuracy, and the growth of the role.



What We Are Looking For



Accuracy is extremely important in this role.



We want someone who does more than simply categorize transactions based on what QuickBooks suggests. You should be able to look at the transaction, understand the business activity, understand the Chart of Accounts, and determine whether the accounting treatment makes sense.



If you are unsure, we expect you to ask. We would rather have a clearly documented question than an incorrect assumption.



At the same time, we value people who are resourceful and will investigate an issue before immediately asking someone else for the answer.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A brief introduction about yourself and your bookkeeping experience.

How many years of QuickBooks Online experience you have.

Whether you have worked with U.S.-based businesses.

Your experience processing or reviewing payroll.

Your experience working with Charts of Accounts.

Your current availability in U.S. Central Time.

Your desired hourly rate.

Any QuickBooks, accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll certifications you currently hold.



Please also answer this question in your application:



A business purchases $650 of materials from Costco. What information would you want to know before d
 which QuickBooks account to categorize the transaction to?



There is not necessarily one correct answer. We are interested in understanding how you think through bookkeeping decisions.

title: Executive Assistant / OBM / Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory.



Right now a large volume of daily operational work sits on the founder's desk. Around 45 recurring administrative and IT tasks are documented, along with a long tail of requests that have never been written down at all. This role takes them over.



The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets,
 threads, and automations with custom software, with the first phase going live shortly. A lot of what you learn manually in your first months will be automated in your later ones. They need someone who understands why the current process works the way it does, so that when the new system takes over, someone there can still tell when it is producing the wrong answer.



Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no department to hand something to. If you spot a problem, you either own it or you flag it, and both are fine. Priorities move, several things run at once, and you will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between. As the company grows this role will change shape more than once. That suits some people and frustrates others, and it is worth knowing which one you are before you apply.



This is not a role where you wait to be told the same thing twice. You learn a process, run it correctly, write down what the instructions were missing, and then help make it faster.



What You'll Own



Workflow, Automation and Documentation (about 40%)



Learn each recurring process by running it manually and correctly before proposing to change it

Write and update standard operating procedures as you go, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong

Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive work, stored in portable form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform

Maintain existing automations across the connected tools: diagnose failures, find where a handoff broke, fix or escalate

Review automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct. An automation that quietly produces the wrong result is worse than a manual step, and catching that is part of this role.

Support the rollout of the new operating platform: test workflows, migrate and clean data, own the approval steps the system routes to a person, and report what is not working

Complete the outstanding data migration work, including backfilling historical engagement records that were never entered into the system of record

Maintain the SOP library and the automation library side by side, with consistent naming and version control

Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it

Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed. This is the primary measure of the role.



Operations Execution (about 40%)



Run the new-engagement launch sequence, two to three times a week, across four connected systems

Act as the operational glue: keep projects moving, chase what is stuck, and handle the daily requests that keep the firm running

Take on work delegated directly by the Managing Director, ranging from research and follow-up to standing responsibilities that move off her desk permanently as you demonstrate you can hold them

Quality check the output of the processes you run and the automations you build: verify results against the source, catch errors before they reach a client or a report, and correct the process rather than only the instance

Support the quality review process: upload and format audit reports, run and check an AI-assisted first-pass review, track what is waiting on whom, and keep reports from stalling between reviewer and auditor. (You will not perform the review or make audit judgments — you keep the queue moving.)

Handle certificate of insurance requests, vendor onboarding packets, and W-9 issuance

Maintain the vendor and subcontractor register and the supporting documentation set

Calendar and inbox support for leadership, including meeting notes, action item tracking, and follow-through to completion



Systems Administration and Records (about 20%)



Provision accounts and access for new team members across Google Workspace and eight other platforms, and support onboarding and offboarding

Maintain the Google Drive structure, permissions, naming conventions, and file cleanup

Maintain the software subscription register: what renews when, what nobody uses, what should be cancelled

Maintain
 marketing list hygiene: before every send, confirm no unsubscribed contacts remain on the active mailing list

Support hiring logistics, credential tracking, and HR administration



Bookkeeping and finance are a separate role. You will work alongside the bookkeeper, and there are handoff points between you, but you do not own the finance cycle.



What You Bring



Six or more years in an operations, executive assistant, business management, or process coordination role supporting leadership directly

Experience in a company where processes were not fully documented, and you were part of fixing that

Demonstrated experience building or maintaining workflows and automations, in any tool

Excellent written English. You will draft internal and occasional external communications.

Proven ability to follow a written procedure exactly, and to notice and report when the procedure is wrong

Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to tell us about a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you check that its output is correct.

Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly

Comfort with systems administration: user provisioning, permissions, and file structure

Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet space for video calls

Ability to commit to heavy US Central overlap during onboarding, and four to six hours daily thereafter



Strong advantages



Experience designing or building a CRM, database, or internal system, not only using one

Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms, database automations, or building custom AI skills and agents

Experience building or maintaining a knowledge base, wiki, SOP library, or internal training system

Experience in an ISO-certified environment: document control, internal audits, management systems, quality or environmental standards

Exposure to electronics manufacturing, recycling, IT asset disposition, or data destruction compliance

Experience with relational database tools, time tracking systems, project management platforms, or Google Workspace administration

Experience being part of a software implementation or system migration



Who This Is Not For



This is not a data entry role and not a general virtual assistant role. If you need a stable queue of identical tasks, a defined lane, or a manager who assigns your day, this will frustrate you. If your plan is to run everything through an AI tool and send the first thing it produces, you will not pass our assessment. We care as much about how you check work as how you produce it.



How Success Is Measured



A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left

Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow

Errors found by quality checks before they reach a client, a report, or leadership

Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly

Engagement launches completed within the defined window, with no missed setup steps

Audit reports moved through the review queue without stalling

Access provisioning and deprovisioning completed within the defined period, with no orphaned accounts

The task and question log maintained continuously and reviewed on cycle

Zero sends to a mailing list containing unsubscribed contacts



How to Apply

Complete our application form here: 



It takes about ten minutes. To confirm you have read this posting in full, include the code OPS-2026-READ where the application asks for it. We will respond to every applicant who completes the form.

 StillPoint Studios | Remote (Full-Time)

title: PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER
description:
PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER



Social Media Marketing | Reels | TikTok | Content Strategy -



HAIR INDUSTRY 



Remote | Philippines

Part-Time Initially | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



I’m an Australian hairloss educator , hairloss clinic and salon owner and founder looking for a creative, experienced Content Manager to take ownership of my personal brand and professional education content.



I already have someone managing the regular social media content for my hair salon this is for my personal Instagram + TikTok 



This role is specifically focused on my personal brand and professional hair education.



I create a LOT of content.



I need someone to help me create my course sales and gain my clients this isn’t about followers. 



Videos, photos, client transformations, education, training days, behind-the-scenes footage, business content, voice notes, ideas and everyday moments.



My problem isn’t having things to talk about.



My problem is consistently turning everything I have into great content and actually getting it posted.



That’s where you come in.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



I want us to work together initially to create a clear content strategy.



We’ll establish:



* What we’re trying to achieve

* Who we’re speaking to

* What we want to grow

* What we want to promote

* The different areas of my personal brand

* My professional education goals

* How frequently we should be posting

* What types of content we need



You don’t need to magically understand my voice on day one.



You’ll learn that by working with me.



But once we’ve established the direction together, I need you to take charge of making it happen every single week.



I don’t want consistency to rely on whether I’ve had time to sit down and create a Reel.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



TAKE WHAT I GIVE YOU AND TURN IT INTO CONTENT.



I will provide the raw material (you will create what raw material is needed) 



You will:



* Organise it

* D
 how we can use it

* Find the strongest angles

* Create the hooks

* Edit the videos

* Turn them into Reels and TikToks

* Create carousels/posts where appropriate

* Write captions

* Create supporting Stories

* Repurpose content

* Schedule it

* Post it

* Keep everything organised

* Make sure we’re consistently showing up every week



You should be able to take one folder of footage and see multiple pieces of content inside it.



If I send you a 10-minute video, you should be thinking about the Reel, TikToks, educational clips, Story content and anything else we can create from it.



INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK



You’ll be responsible for taking the content I provide and turning it into engaging content for both Instagram and TikTok.



I don’t necessarily want the exact same piece blindly posted everywhere.



You should understand how content can be adapted for each platform while still allowing us to work efficiently and repurpose what we create.



You need to be FAST and confident with short-form video editing.



I don’t want footage sitting unused for weeks because nobody has had time to do anything with it.



KEEP ME CONSISTENT



This is a huge part of the role.



I need someone who keeps the content moving.



You’ll maintain the content calendar and know:



What’s being posted this week?

What’s already edited?

What’s waiting for approval?

What content do we have available?

What are we missing?

What do you need me to film next?



I don’t want to have to remember to ask you what content you need.



I want YOU to ask ME.



For example:



“This is what we’re posting next week. I have four pieces ready, but I need you to film these two things for me.”



Or:



“We need more content around this topic. Can you answer these three questions on camera and send them to me?”



That’s the relationship I’m looking for.



PERSONAL BRAND



You’ll work closely with me to understand my personal brand over time.



My content covers areas including:



Hair | Hair Loss | Business | Education | Leadership | Founder Life | Behind the Scenes | Personal/Lifestyle



Some content is fun and fast.



Some is educational.



Some is opinion or founder-led.



Some is very personal.



And some of the work we do with hair-loss clients can be extremely emotional.



I need someone who understands storytelling and human emotion, not just transitions and trending audio.



As we work together, I want you to become increasingly confident at recognising:



“This sounds like her.”



And equally:



“She would never post this.”



PROFESSIONAL HAIR EDUCATION



A major part of the role will also be consistently marketing and growing my professional hair education.



I don’t only want to post when I’m selling training.



We need to consistently nurture the audience so hair professionals:



Discover me → Learn from me → Follow me → Trust me → Engage → Eventually want to train with me.



You’ll help create and publish content around:



* Education

* Training days

* My expertise

* Student results

* Student transformations

* Testimonials

* Behind the scenes

* Industry education

* FAQs

* Common objections

* Case studies

* Success stories

* Upcoming training

* Educational tips

* Content that builds authority

* Content that nurtures potential students



You’ll also help engage with the audience, respond to comments and appropriate DMs, and identify what potential students are asking about so we can create more content around those topics.



I don’t want spammy sales outreach.



I want genuine community building and consistent nurturing.



BRING ME IDEAS



Although I’ll provide lots of the raw content and we’ll set the strategy together, I don’t want to be responsible for thinking of everything forever.



Once you understand the goals, I want you to start bringing ideas to me.



Tell me:



What should we create?

What are we missing?

What should I film?

What should we talk about more?

What performed well?

What should we repeat?

What are people asking us about?



I want someone who becomes another creative brain behind the brand.



HAIR & BEAUTY EXPERIENCE



Experience creating content within the hair or beauty industry is strongly preferred.



Particularly:



Hair salons

Hair extensions

Haircare

Hair loss

Beauty brands

Beauty educators

Hair educators

Beauty/hair personal brands

title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator Custom Artwork /

Sports Apparel / Illustration / Seamless Patterns



$12–$20 USD/hour | Long-Term | Approximately 15–25 Hours/Week



We are looking for an exceptionally creative, senior-level graphic

designer and illustrator to join our team on an ongoing freelance basis.



CREATIVITY IS THE #1 REQUIREMENT FOR THIS ROLE.



This is not primarily a production design position. We are not looking

for someone who simply places logos on templates, follows detailed

instructions, or waits to be told exactly what to create.



We need an outstanding visual designer who can be given very limited

creative direction and develop the idea themselves.



Your primary responsibility will be creating custom artwork and product

graphics based on customer logos, brands, themes, and design requests.



A typical project may begin with nothing more than:



A customer’s logo + a few colors + a short sentence describing what they

want.



From there, you are the creative.



You will be expected to determine the visual direction and create the

patterns, illustrations, icons, typography, supporting graphics,

layouts, and other artwork necessary to turn that limited information

into an exceptional finished collection.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



-   Interpret customer requests with very little creative direction

-   Develop original visual concepts independently

-   Create original graphics and artwork for apparel and other products

-   Design cohesive collections across multiple products

-   Determine how artwork should merchandise across different products

    rather than simply repeating the same design

-   Create original vector illustrations, icons, badges, logos,

    typography, and supporting artwork

-   Create sophisticated seamless repeating patterns

-   Work with customer logos and existing brand assets

-   Recreate low-resolution customer logos as clean vector artwork when

    necessary

-   Develop artwork specifically for sublimated sports/performance

    apparel

-   Adapt creative concepts across apparel, accessories, and other

    products

-   Use AI intelligently to accelerate portions of the creative process

    when appropriate

-   Take feedback well and quickly develop revised creative solutions



CREATIVITY IS ESSENTIAL



We cannot emphasize this enough.



We are looking for someone with excellent taste, strong visual

instincts, and the ability to generate ideas independently.



If you require detailed creative briefs, sketches, or step-by-step

instructions before you can begin designing, this will not be the right

position for you.



We want someone who can look at a customer’s brand, understand its

personality, and think:



“Here are five interesting directions we could take this.”



Not:



“What exactly would you like me to make?”



You should be comfortable making creative decisions yourself and

presenting strong solutions rather than waiting for someone else to

solve the creative problem for you.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL



You must be an exceptional Adobe Illustrator user.



You should be able to work quickly and confidently with complex vector

artwork without assistance.



You must have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.



We will train you on our internal processes. We will not train you on

design software.



Illustration — STRONG/EXPERT



You must actually be able to illustrate.



This includes creating:



-   Original vector graphics

-   Icons

-   Logos and badges

-   Custom typography

-   Mascots/characters when needed

-   Graphic elements

-   Pattern assets

-   Supporting collection artwork



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is arranging stock

assets.



Seamless Patterns — ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED



You must know how to professionally create seamless repeating patterns

in:



Adobe Illustrator AND Adobe Photoshop.



This is a core requirement of the position.



Sports / Sublimated Apparel Experience



You should have professional experience designing for sports,

performance, or sublimated apparel.



Experience with categories such as golf, cycling, running, outdoor, team

sports, or similar products is highly desirable.



You must understand how artwork interacts with garment panels and how to

design a collection that works across multiple product types.



AI EXPERIENCE



We actively use AI as a creative accelerator, and you should be

comfortable doing the same.



You should understand how to use modern AI creative tools to help:



-   Explore concepts

-   Generate reference material

-   Develop supporting assets

-   Accelerate illustration

-   Explore compositions

-   Generate ideas faster



However, the finished work cannot look AI-generated.



AI is a tool—not a substitute for design ability.



You must have the taste and technical ability to recognize poor AI

output, refine/rebuild assets when necessary, and turn generated ideas

into polished, professional artwork.



A great designer using AI should become faster and more capable, not

produce generic AI artwork.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



-   Extremely creative

-   A genuinely strong visual problem solver

-   A senior-level designer, not someone still learning their craft

-   An excellent illustrator

-   Highly self-sufficient

-   Fast in Adobe Illustrator

-   Comfortable starting with very limited direction

-   Able to take constructive feedback without becoming dependent on

    direction

-   Capable of switching between completely different visual styles

-   Excellent at color, typography, composition, and pattern

-   Able to understand a brand quickly

-   Organized and reliable

-   Comfortable managing multiple custom projects

-   Excited about making genuinely cool artwork



Creativity and portfolio quality matter more to us than years of

experience or formal education.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



This is intended to become a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Our target is approximately 25 hours per week at $12–$15 USD/hour,

depending on experience, speed, and portfolio quality.



However:



We are willing to pay up to $20 USD/hour for an exceptional designer,

even if that means fewer guaranteed weekly hours.



We would rather have 15–20 hours from an incredible designer than 25

hours from an average one.



During busy periods, there may also be opportunities to take on

additional projects/hours for additional compensation or performance

bonuses, based on availability.



PORTFOLIO REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS



Do not apply without a portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



We especially want to see:



-   Your most creative work

-   Sports/performance apparel graphics

-   Sublimated apparel

-   Complete coordinated collections

-   Seamless patterns

-   Original vector illustration

-   Logos, badges, and icons you personally created

-   Projects where you developed the creative direction yourself



We are not particularly interested in portfolios dominated by social

media graphics, corporate presentations, UI/UX, Canva templates, or

generic branding projects.



We want to see ARTWORK.



TO APPLY



Please include:



1.  Portfolio link — REQUIRED

2.  Show us the 3 projects that best demonstrate how creative you are.

3.  Show us a sports/apparel collection you personally designed.

4.  Show us at least 2 seamless patterns you personally built and tell

    us what software you used to create them.

5.  Show us examples of your original vector illustration work.

6.  Describe your experience with sublimated apparel.

7.  Tell us which AI creative tools you currently use and how they fit

    into your design process.

8.  Confirm that you have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.

9.  Confirm your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.



FINAL CREATIVE QUESTION:



Imagine a customer gives you only their logo, brand colors, and the

words “retro tropical golf.” They want a collection but provide no

additional creative direction.



Briefly describe the first 3 visual concepts you would explore.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

title: Book Review Outreach and Promotion Specialist
description:
Job Type: Part-Time / Freelance

Work Location: Remote



Industry: Book Publishing / Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP)

Position Overview



I am seeking a dependable and organized Book Review Outreach and Promotion Specialist to help increase the visibility of books published through Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing.

The ideal candidate will understand ethical book promotion, Amazon’s review policies, and the rules of third-party websites. This person will identify legitimate opportunities for book reviews, submit or place books on appropriate websites, track results, and provide a detailed monthly report.

This position is focused on building long-term visibility and reader engagement. It does not involve purchasing reviews, creating fake accounts, writing reviews for readers, or guaranteeing positive ratings.



Key Responsibilities

Book Review Outreach

Research legitimate book review websites, book blogs, newsletters, podcasts, reading groups, and reviewer communities.

Identify reviewers whose interests match each book’s genre and target audience.

Submit books to reviewers according to each reviewer’s submission requirements.

Prepare professional and personalized outreach messages.

Maintain a record of every reviewer contacted.

Follow up professionally when permitted.

Track accepted, declined, pending, and completed review requests.

Provide reviewers with approved digital or print copies when authorized.

Never request, pressure, or guarantee a positive review.

Third-Party Book Placement

Find reputable websites where books can be listed, featured, promoted, reviewed, or submitted.

Place books on free and paid promotional websites after receiving approval.

Review each site’s rules before submitting a book.

Ensure book descriptions, author information, categories, pricing, links, and cover images are accurate.

Track submission dates, publication dates, fees, results, and expiration dates.

Recommend new promotional opportunities based on genre, audience, price, and expected value.

Avoid websites that use fake traffic, automated reviews, review exchanges, or misleading promises.



KDP and Policy Compliance

Understand and follow Amazon KDP and customer-review policies.

Keep up with policy changes that may affect book reviews and promotions.

Avoid compensated reviews, review manipulation, fake reviews, and prohibited review exchanges.

Do not ask friends, relatives, employees, or individuals with a close personal or financial relationship to post reviews.

Follow the rules of Goodreads, BookBub, social media platforms, review websites, and promotional services.

Immediately report any questionable opportunity before submitting a book or making a payment.



Tracking and Monthly Reports

Provide a monthly report that includes:

Books promoted during the month.

Reviewers and websites contacted.

Dates of all submissions.

Free and paid placements completed.

Amount spent on each placement.

Pending, accepted, declined, and completed review requests.

Links to published reviews and promotional listings.

New Amazon reviews received during the reporting period.

Changes in each book’s average rating and total review count.

Website traffic, clicks, downloads, sales, or other available results.

Problems, policy concerns, or negative feedback discovered.

title: PayPal Dispute & Chargeback Manager (E-commerce)
description:
We are Leichtkraut, a growing health and wellness brand from Germany.

We sell a natural herbal supplement. Every day, a few of our customers open

a PayPal case instead of writing to us first. Your job is to win those cases

back and to keep our dispute rate low.



***!!!IMPORTANT: This position is for women only!!!***

Male applicants will not be considered. Please do not apply.



THE ROLE

- Work our PayPal Resolution Center every single day

- Sort every new case by deadline. A case with no answer is a case we lost

- Upload the tracking proof. Most of our cases are won exactly there, and they are won fast

- Build the evidence when a case needs more: order confirmation, proof of delivery, full
 history

- Write the response inside the case. Short, factual, backed by proof

- Communicate with our supplier whenever tracking or proof of delivery is missing or unclear

- Log every single case in our backend sheet: date, order number, case type, amount, deadline, status, outcome

- D
 when we defend and when we refund. You get clear rules from us

- Send one short report every week: cases, won, lost, refunded, dispute rate

- Part-time to start, long-term, with more hours as volume grows



PAY AND GROWTH

- You start at $50 per week

- Right now our claim and chargeback volume is low, so the workload is small and the pay reflects that

- In Q4 the volume goes up a lot. More orders means more claims and more chargebacks. As that happens, this role can grow to several hundred dollars per week

- This is real, not a line on paper. We would rather pay one excellent person properly than three average ones cheaply. If you win cases, you will move up.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us a DM here with exactly TWO things:



1. The link to your video (Loom or Google Drive)

2. Your WhatsApp number



Nothing else. No long message.

If your video convinces us, we will contact you on WhatsApp.

No video means no reply.



YOUR VIDEO (5 to 10 minutes) - please cover all of this:

- Your name, your age, where you are based

- Exactly how long you have handled PayPal disputes or chargebacks (years and months)

- Which companies or brands, and what they sold

- Which payment providers you have worked with (PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, Shopify Payments)

- Which tools you have used (PayPal Resolution Center, Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Google Sheets)

- How many disputes you handled per week, and roughly what share of them you won

- Tell us about one case you LOST, and what you would do differently today

- How you handle a case where tracking says delivered but the customer says nothing arrived

- Any experience working with suppliers or fulfilment partners to get proof of delivery

- How you keep track of many open cases at once. Show us your system if you have one

- Any experience with health, beauty or supplement brands

- Your English level, and any experience with German or translation tools

- Your available hours in your local time, and your earliest start date

- Your internet speed and your work setup



Speak freely and take your time. The more we see of you in this video,

the faster we can move you forward.

title: Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC E-commerce / Meta Ads
description:
Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC / Meta Ads



We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Video Editor to become a key part of our DTC e-commerce operation.



We are currently doing 5 figures in daily revenue and our goal is to scale toward $100,000+ per day.



Creative is one of the most important parts of our growth, and we are looking for someone who can eventually take significant ownership of the creative side of the brand.



This is NOT just a video editing position.



We need someone who understands Meta Ads, direct-response marketing, creative strategy, customer psychology and performance creative — while also being able to execute and edit high-quality video ads.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your job will be to help us produce, analyze and continuously improve performance creatives for Meta.



You will:



Develop and execute new Meta ad creatives

Study our winning ads and understand why they are working

Build new iterations and executions from proven winning concepts

Develop new hooks, openings, scripts and variations

Edit high-performing direct-response video ads

Create UGC-style ads, VSLs, advertorial-style ads and other performance formats

Research competitors and the market to identify new opportunities

Understand our customer, their problems, desires and buying motivations

Analyze creative performance and use the data to d
 what should be created next

Identify creative fatigue and produce new iterations before winners stop performing

Work with Meta Ads performance data rather than creating based purely on personal preference

Continuously test new ideas while scaling what already works



As you prove yourself, the goal is for you to take more and more ownership of the brand's creative strategy and production.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have a strong understanding of:



Meta Ads

DTC e-commerce

Direct-response marketing

Creative strategy

Video editing

Hooks and angles

Customer psychology

UGC advertising

VSLs

Creative testing

Creative iteration

Competitor and market research

Performance metrics

Scaling creatives as ad spend increases



You should understand that a good-looking video is not necessarily a good ad.



We care about performance.



You should be able to look at an existing winning ad, understand the underlying message, angle, psychology and structure, and use those learnings to create new ads that can potentially outperform it.



IMPORTANT – 2 TEST VIDEO ADS REQUIRED



Please read this before applying.



The first step of our hiring process is creating 2 test video ads for our brand.



We are NOT asking you to figure everything out from zero.



We will give you our winning ads and show you the concepts, messaging and angles that are currently working for us.



From there, we want you to study the winners, understand why they work, and show us what you can create from that information.



Your task will be to create 2 complete video ads that you believe could perform on Meta.



You can use our winning ads as inspiration and direction, but we do not want simple copies.



We want to see whether you can take something that is already proven and create new hooks, iterations, executions and ideas around the winning message.



We will evaluate:



Your understanding of our winning ads

Your creative strategy

Your hooks

Your ability to build on proven concepts

Your direct-response thinking

Your video editing

Your pacing and storytelling

Your understanding of Meta advertising

Your ability to create something that could realistically become another winning ad

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU WON'T DO THE TEST



We want to be very clear about this.



If you are not willing to create the 2 test video ads, please do not apply.



If you only send us a CV, generic cover letter or portfolio and are unwilling to complete the test, we will not move forward with your application.



We are looking for serious candidates who are willing to show us what they can actually do.



WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE TEST?



If we like your 2 test ads, we will invite you to an interview.



During the interview, we will discuss:



Your decisions behind the test creatives

Why you chose your hooks and structure

Your previous DTC experience

Your Meta Ads knowledge

How you analyze winners and losers

How you would approach creative testing at higher spend

How you could help us build and improve our creative operation



The strongest candidate will have the opportunity to join us full-time and long-term.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are not looking for someone to edit a few videos and disappear.



We want someone who can become an important part of the company as we scale from 5 figures/day toward $100,000+ in daily revenue.



If you're good, there will be room for more responsibility, higher compensation and eventually significant ownership over the creative operation.



We move fast, test aggressively and care about results.



If you're a Creative Strategist who can also execute and edit, understand Meta performance marketing, and want to build alongside a rapidly growing DTC operation, we'd like to see what you can do.



INVESTMENT IN YOUR GROWTH



If you get accepted and join our team, we will pay for Evolve for you — a premium training program worth $2,000/month.



We want you to continuously improve as a Creative Strategist and stay at the highest level of performance creative, Meta Ads and DTC marketing.



We invest in people who perform. If you grow, we grow.

title: Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager
description:
# Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager



## About Us



We’re an AI-first marketing agency based in Australia, focused on performance, systems, innovation, and building things properly.



We work across paid media, primarily Google Ads and Meta Ads, alongside SEO, automation, AI tools, reporting systems, Shopify, lead generation, and custom internal apps.



We move fast, solve problems quickly, and constantly improve the systems inside the business.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows SOPs.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, identify problems, improve systems, take ownership, and help us scale.



This is not a junior role.



This is a long-term role for somebody who wants to grow with the company and become a core part of the team.



---



## The Role



We are hiring a full-time Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager.



Your role will involve managing campaigns, improving systems, building reporting processes, working with AI tools, solving operational problems, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients.



You will work directly with the founder and become heavily involved in the operational side of the agency.



This is a dynamic role, not a repetitive VA role.



Some weeks you may be:



* launching Meta campaigns

* optimising Google Ads campaigns

* improving reporting systems

* troubleshooting tracking issues

* improving attribution accuracy

* helping build AI workflows

* auditing landing pages

* improving internal systems

* managing Shopify marketing tasks

* identifying inefficiencies before anybody else notices them



We value initiative very highly.



You should already be comfortable independently launching and managing campaigns.



If you wait to be told every small step, this role is not for you.



---



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns

* Setting up and managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Monitoring performance and improving campaign results

* Creating and improving reporting systems

* Building dashboards and client reporting workflows

* Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

* Managing Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and Events Manager setups

* Diagnosing tracking issues and ensuring accurate attribution

* Working with AI tools to improve efficiency

* Assisting with SEO-related tasks and strategy

* Helping improve agency systems and operations

* Identifying problems proactively and solving them independently

* Supporting onboarding workflows for new clients

* Working with Shopify stores where required

* Providing weekly campaign updates and operational updates



Potential future client-facing opportunities are available for candidates with exceptional communication skills and presentation ability.



---



## What We’re Looking For



### Required Skills



* Strong Google Ads experience

* Strong Meta Ads experience

* Good understanding of performance marketing

* Understanding of marketing reporting and analytics

* Comfortable using AI tools daily

* Ability to think independently and solve problems

* Strong written English communication

* Organised and systems-oriented

* High attention to detail



### Highly Valued



* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with GoHighLevel

* Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager

* Strong understanding of GA4

* Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixel and Events Manager

* Experience with attribution and conversion tracking

* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make

* Experience using AI builders/tools such as Lovable

* Basic SEO understanding

* Design eye and understanding of good creative



---



## Growth Opportunity



We are building this role for the long term.



As the company grows, this position will continue to grow and evolve with it.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity for:



* increased responsibility

* leadership opportunities

* involvement in higher-level strategy

* direct collaboration with the founder

* long-term career growth inside the company



This is a remote-first role, however for exceptional long-term tea
mbers, there may also be opportunities over the next 12 to 24 months to become more directly involved with the Australian side of the business if desired.



We are looking for somebody who wants to build something long-term, not somebody looking for a short-term freelance position.



---



## The Type of Person That Will Succeed Here



You:



* take initiative without being asked

* enjoy solving problems

* improve systems naturally

* think critically

* learn quickly

* communicate clearly

* care about results

* want long-term growth

* are comfortable in a fast-moving environment

* use AI to work smarter and faster



You probably will NOT enjoy this role if:



* you need constant supervision

* you wait for instructions for every task

* you avoid ownership

* you struggle with communication

* you prefer repetitive admin-only work



---



## Hours



* Full-time role

* Flexible scheduling where needed

* Must have overlap with Melbourne business hours



---



## To Apply



Please answer the following carefully.



We are not looking for perfect answers. We are looking for your thinking process, problem-solving ability, and how you approach challenges.



### Question 1



Tell us about a marketing or operational problem you noticed before anybody else did.



How did you identify it?

What did you do to solve it?

What was the result?



### Question 2



Imagine a client’s Meta Ads performance suddenly drops by 40% this week.



Walk us through:



* what you would check first

* how you would investigate the issue

* what data you would look at

* what actions you would take



We care far more about your thinking process than having a “perfect” answer.



### Question 3



Tell us about a system or workflow you improved in a previous role.



What was inefficient?

What changes did you make?

What impact did it have?



### Question 4



What AI tools do you currently use in your workflow, and how do they make you more effective?



---



## Final Notes



We are building a high-performance, AI-first agency with strong systems and strong people.



If you are ambitious, proactive, accountable, and want a long-term opportunity where you can grow into a major role inside the company, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Marketing + Graphic Design Associate
description:
We're building the in-house creative function for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for someone we can grow from the ground up — not just a designer who fills briefs, but someone who takes genuine pride in how our brand shows up in public. This role blends design with judgment: you won't just produce assets; you'll read what's actually landing with our audience and adjust.



This is not a template-filling role. You'll be shaping how a financial product presents itself to real users — where a sloppy asset or a careless caption costs us trust, not just engagement. Our audience is discerning, and much of it is Japanese. Quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and reach the right creative call on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for taste. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the brand guidelines, content calendar, and asset library you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want someone who takes initiative to help build them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Design static creative for social, community channels, and campaigns — posts, banners, announcement cards, event graphics, presentation assets

• Own the content calendar: plan it, keep it filled, and keep it shipping on schedule

• Publish and monitor posts across our channels, and track how each one actually performs

• Recognize what's working and bring that back into the next round of creative — not just produce volume

• Report on performance in numbers, not impressions of impressions — you should be comfortable saying which post did what, and why

• Maintain and extend our brand system — colors, type, templates, asset library — so the whole team can move faster

• Use AI tools to sharpen your own well-considered concepts, not to generate work you haven't thought through

• Keep organized, accessible files — versioned, named properly, findable by someone who isn't you

• Escalate anything involving financial claims, promotions, or numbers to your Lead before it goes out — nothing about money publishes unreviewed

• Follow team rules, protocols, and brand guidelines diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every public post is a first impression for someone, and deserves your full presence and care



What We're Looking For:



Non-negotiables — read these carefully:



• Real graphic design experience. Not "I've used Canva." You should have designed for a brand or client with an actual audience, and be able to walk us through your choices.

• A social account you personally ran, with the numbers to show for it. This is the core of your portfolio. We want to see accounts you managed — the graphics you made for them, and the performance behind those posts: impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth over a stated period. Screenshots of your analytics are exactly what we're asking for. A portfolio of pretty graphics with no audience data attached will not get you through this stage.

• Japanese market experience is highly preferred. If you've designed or run social for a Japanese brand, a Japan-facing account, or a JP audience — say so early and show it. This is the single biggest differentiator in this search.



Also required:



• Strong with Figma, Canva, or Adobe — whichever you use, you should be genuinely fluent in it

• A body of work that shows range and taste — we care far more about what you've actually made than where you studied

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you can explain why you made a design choice, and defend it or drop it without going quiet

• Understands hierarchy — you know what you can ship yourself and what needs your Lead's eyes, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — deadlines hold, files are clean, nothing gets published with a typo in it

• Audience-minded — you can tell the difference between a post that looks nice and a post that works

• Follows rules diligently — brand guidelines aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional, and able to write a caption that doesn't sound like a press release

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a brief yourself, not just execute the literal request

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll see campaign plans and product information before they're public

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level Japanese — especially if you can review Japanese-language creative for tone, not just accuracy

• Short-form video or motion graphics ability (Reels, TikTok, CapCut, After Effects)

• Experience running paid social or reading analytics beyond surface-level metrics

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products — and the visual language that comes with them

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• Meta Blueprint, HubSpot Marketing, or similar certification

• Has grown an account from zero to a real audience

• Illustration, 3D, or photography skills



Reporting to: Growth Operations Lead and CMO



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• Flexible hours, output-based — you'll need meaningful overlap with Philippine business hours (JST business hours) for team syncs and reviews, but we're not counting the hours you spend at your desk

• No time tracker

• Deadlines are firm; how you get there is yours to manage

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — your own machine capable of running your design tools, plus stable fiber internet

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you see any campaign or product information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your work is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[Social + Design] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then send the following. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. Your portfolio, which must include:



The social account(s) you personally ran — handle or link, and what your actual role was (you ran it solo, you handled design only, you shared it with a team — just be honest)

The numbers. Impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth, over a period you state clearly. Analytics screenshots are ideal. If an account was small, show it anyway — we'd rather see 3,000 real followers you grew than a vague claim about a big one.

The graphics you made for those accounts — so we can connect the design work to the results it produced

Any Japanese-market work, called out specifically



If your best work is under NDA or on an account you no longer have access to, tell us what you can and show what you have. We're reasonable about this — we're not reasonable about people who skip the numbers entirely.



2. Answer all three questions:



Pick your best-performing post and your worst-performing post from the same account. What was different about them? (Numbers, then your read on why.)

If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

Think of a time you were part of a startup, org, or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write or ideate is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it, and we can tell when a portfolio piece was generated rather than made. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, creative, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line, a portfolio with performance numbers, and all three answers will not be reviewed.
