title: Copywriter / Copy Editor — Direct Response Health Funnels
description:
Rate: €10/hour

Schedule: Part-time, flexible hours

Employment type: Long-term, direct hire (no agency)

Location: 100% remote





About the Company



We own and operate multiple direct-to-consumer health & wellness brands selling in the UK, Ireland, Poland, Mexico, French Canada, and Switzerland. We run all advertising in-house on Meta and Google Ads. Our team already includes strategists, video editors, graphic editors, and funnel builders — and we are growing.



We are looking for one sharp Copywriter / Copy Editor to join us long-term.





About the Job



We build advertorials (long-form editorial-style landing pages) and sales pages for our health brands. The first draft is generated using AI with detailed strategy briefs and style guides. Your job is to take that AI output and make it sound like a real person wrote it — tightening the language, fixing awkward phrasing, strengthening emotional beats, and making sure the copy actually sells.



You are not writing from scratch. You are reviewing, rewriting, and polishing.



Your tasks:

- Review AI-generated advertorials and sales pages against our internal style guide

- Rewrite sections that sound robotic, generic, or flat — make them persuasive and natural

- Strengthen patient stories, testimonials, and emotional copy so they feel real and specific

- Ensure mechanism explanations are clear, simple, and compelling — not overly technical

- Check that headlines, subheadlines, and CTAs are sharp and direct

- Verify consistency across the full funnel (advertorial claims match the sales page, stats are identical everywhere, guarantee language is consistent)

- Flag anything that feels off — weak sections, missing proof, unclear logic, or claims that don't land

- Deliver clean, ready-to-publish copy back to us



You do not need to know how to use AI tools or write prompts — that is handled by someone else. You just receive the output and make it better with your copywriting skills.



We have complete style guides, frameworks, and examples ready. You will be trained on our exact process and standards.





Requirements

- At least 2 years of experience writing or editing direct response copy (advertorials, long-form landing pages, sales pages, or VSLs)

- You understand what makes copy sell — emotional hooks, identification, objection handling, urgency, proof stacking — not just what makes it grammatically correct

- Strong feel for natural, conversational English — you can spot when a sentence sounds like a machine wrote it

- Reliable internet, own computer, and available for consistent part-time hours

- Honest, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

- This role cannot be combined with another full-time job



Big advantages (not required, but will put you ahead):

- Experience in health, beauty, or skincare copy

- Experience with gadget or device marketing

- Familiarity with the advertorial format (editorial-style pre-sell pages)

- Understanding of awareness stages and funnel structure





Benefits

- €10/hour — paid reliably, on time, every month

- Paid leave — real paid days off, not just unpaid vacation

- Long-term security — many of our team members have been with us for years; we invest in training and promote from within

- Flexible part-time schedule (no fixed shift — we care about output, not clock-watching)

- Work with an experienced international team across multiple markets

- Clear style guides and SOPs — you always know what is expected





How to Apply



To make sure you read this post carefully, start your application with the word WATERMELON in the subject line or first line.



Then include:

1. A sample of your best direct response copy — an advertorial, sales page, or long-form landing page where YOU wrote or rewrote the copy (link or PDF)

2. Answer this question: pick one section from your sample and explain what makes it persuasive — what is it doing to the reader and why does it work?

3. Your availability (hours per week) and earliest start date



Applications without the word WATERMELON or without a writing sample will not be considered.



We personally read every application and reply to all qualified candidates within 5 business days.

title: (Harriet) Social Media Content Strategist & Manager - Financial Education Brand
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

• Location: Remote

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Position: Part-Time

• Hours: 20 hours per week

• Pay: $250 per month

• Brand: Financial Education / Personal Finance

• Time Zone: Availability to overlap with UK working hours



ABOUT THE ROLE

I’m looking for a hands-on Content Strategist & Social Media Manager to help grow a personal financial education brand.

This is not simply a role where you will be given a list of posts to create each week. I need someone who can think strategically, understand an audience, research competitors, analyse content and performance, identify opportunities and take ownership of the process from research → strategy → content creation → scheduling → analytics → optimisation.



You should be comfortable working independently, bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you believe certain content will work.



THE MAIN GOAL

Growth is important, but going viral for the sake of going viral isn’t the goal.

The priority is attracting the right audience and turning that attention into genuine interest and qualified leads for the brand’s online masterclass and educational offers.

I want someone who understands the difference between vanity metrics and meaningful results.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Strategy & Research

• Research the target audience, including their questions, problems, fears, objections and interests.

• Research competitors and successful creators in the financial education/personal finance space.

• Analyse existing content and identify what is working, what isn’t and why.

• Develop and maintain content pillars, themes and a platform-specific strategy.

• Identify content gaps, trends and opportunities.

• Use analytics to continually improve the strategy.



Content Creation

• Develop content ideas, angles and hooks.

• Write short-form and long-form video scripts, captions, titles and descriptions.

• Adapt content to the brand’s voice and different platforms.

• Edit short-form and long-form video.

• Create social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails.

• Repurpose existing content into new formats.

AI can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must have genuine human judgement, creativity and personality.



Planning & Publishing

• Build and manage the content calendar.

• Schedule and publish content across relevant platforms.

• Ensure content, captions, CTAs, links and formatting are correct.

• Keep the content workflow organised and ahead of schedule.

• Set up, manage and optimise ManyChat automations and workflows, including connecting relevant content CTAs to automated conversations and lead-generation sequences.



Analytics & Growth

• Monitor views, watch time, retention, engagement, saves, shares, comments and other relevant metrics.

• Identify patterns and use the data to recommend what to create more of, change or stop.

• Look beyond follower growth and views to assess whether we’re attracting the right people.

• Identify high-performing content and develop new angles and repurposing opportunities.

• Support testing of hooks, titles, thumbnails and CTAs.



Community

• Monitor and respond to comments and basic messages.

• Identify audience questions and conversations that could become future content.

• Escalate anything requiring my input.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

• Experience in content strategy and social media management, preferably for a personal brand, creator, coach, educator or similar business.

• Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

• Strong copywriting and scripting ability.

• Excellent understanding of audience and competitor research.

• Ability to analyse content performance and turn data into action.

• Strong video editing skills.

• Strong graphic design skills, including creating social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails.

• Understanding of SEO/keyword research for social media and YouTube.

• Experience with ManyChat, or the ability to learn and set up automations independently.

• Able to work independently and take ownership.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



AI & ORIGINALITY

**Please read this carefully before applying**



AI tools can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must demonstrate your own creativity, judgement and understanding of the audience and brand.



I’m looking for someone who can take an idea, develop it, add their own perspective and create content that feels natural, engaging and authentic, rather than generic or formulaic.



If you rely heavily on AI to produce your content without adding meaningful human input, this role will not be the right fit for you.



APPLICATION & SELECTION PROCESS

Please note that shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical trial before a hiring decision is made.

The trial will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to think strategically, understand an audience, develop content ideas, write scripts and create content.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer these 4 questions in your application:

1. Please share social media accounts that you’ve personally worked on or managed and briefly explain your role and what you were responsible for.



2. Please share links to examples of content you have personally created, particularly scripts, hooks, captions, videos or other social media content.



3. Imagine you are taking over the social media for a personal brand you’ve never worked with before. What would you want to understand first before creating or recommending content?



4. What tools do you currently use for content creation, scheduling, analytics, SEO/keyword research, video editing and ManyChat?



Please make sure your answers are your own and give us a genuine understanding of your experience and approach.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — UGC & Social Media
description:
We’re hiring a reliable full-time video editor to join Lever UGC and edit high-volume TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is primarily straightforward, repeatable editing—not complex cinematic production. Every assignment arrives through our organized Editing Bay with labeled A-roll, B-roll, music, instructions, and inspiration videos.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Turn organized footage into engaging short-form videos

• Match the pacing, captions, music, and structure of reference videos

• Remove pauses and keep videos fast and engaging

• Add clean captions, B-roll, music, and simple effects

• Complete revisions accurately and quickly

• Keep project files and exports organized

• Communicate immediately when footage or instructions are missing



SCHEDULE AND PAY



• 40 hours per week across six working days

• One fixed rest day each week

• Starting pay: $4 USD/hour

• Paid weekly during the initial trial

• 14-day paid production trial

• Compensation review after 30 days based on reliability, quality, and output

• Long-term opportunity with increased pay and responsibility



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



• First drafts targeted within 8 working hours and delivered within 12 working hours

• Build toward 12–15 approved videos per day after training

• Follow references and instructions closely

• Consistently meet deadlines

• Respond well to direct feedback



REQUIREMENTS



• Portfolio of TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts

• Reliable computer capable of editing efficiently

• Stable, fast internet connection

• Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Desktop

• Strong attention to detail and written English

• Reliable communication and availability

• Willingness to learn repeatable editing formats



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



A short introduction

Three short-form videos you personally edited

Your editing software and computer specifications

Your internet speed

Your preferred working hours in Philippine Time

Why you’re interested in a long-term editing position

Begin your application with the words “LEVER EDITOR” so we know you read the complete posting.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing test.

title: Content & Marketing Assistant for US Media Production Company
description:

About us: LeClair Media is a commercial photo and video company in Florida. We shoot for manufacturers, healthcare companies, and home builders across the US. We have a backlog of years of great work and no one publishing it - that's where you come in!

Write blog posts and case studies from our finished projects and publish them on our Squarespace site

Write and post content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Threads in the owner's voice (he approves, you post)

Plan the edits: we have a full-time video editor, so you'll go through project footage, d
 what videos we need for each platform, and brief the editor. You don't edit, you direct what gets edited.

Build the monthly posting schedule and keep it running. Target cadence: LinkedIn 3x/week, Instagram 3-4x/week, Threads 4-5x/week, and 2 blog posts or case studies a month.

Write
s to potential leads and follow up with them. The goal is booking meetings for the owner.

Keep our Google Sheet tracker updated every Friday



Must have:



Excellent written English. Your drafts should need approval, not editing.

Experience writing LinkedIn or Instagram content for a business owner or brand

Can write a cold
 a busy marketing director would reply to, and follow up without being pushy

Good eye for which moments in raw footage make a strong short clip

title: Producer / Delivery Manager for AI Video Agency (Full Time, Long Term)
description:
We produce AI generated video ads for international brands, mostly telehealth and health. Volume has grown past what I can coordinate alone, and I am hiring a producer to run delivery.



This is not a virtual assistant role. You will own whether work ships on time and to standard.



What the job actually is



I hand you a brief. You take it from there.



That means breaking it into tasks, assigning to the right person on the team, chasing whatever assets we are missing, checking the work before it comes back to me, and tracking deadlines across several clients at once.



The part that matters most is quality control. When a video comes back, you need to spot that the character changed between scenes, or the product name is mispronounced, or it does not match the brief. If you cannot tell good work from mediocre work, this role will not suit you.



Who this is for

-You have coordinated creative or production work before, agency side ideally

-You are comfortable chasing people and holding a deadline without being unpleasant about it

-You notice detail. Small errors bother you

-You can look at a piece of video and say specifically what is wrong with it

-You communicate clearly and quickly, and you follow up without being reminded

-You want a long term role where you own something



Who this is not for

-You want to be told exactly what to do each day

-You avoid difficult conversations

-You are looking for a stepping stone into your own agency

-You juggle several clients and would treat this as one of many



What you get

-Direct training from me on our standards and process

-Real ownership. You run delivery, not a task list

-A business that is growing quickly, with international clients, and a role that grows with it

-Salary reviewed on performance, not on time served



Full time, 40 hours a week, Philippine business hours. Fully remote.



Requirements

-Reliable internet and a computer that handles video review

-Good written English

-Experience coordinating work across a team, in any creative or production context

-Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement. Client work is private



How to apply



Read this properly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word ANCHOR so I know you read the whole post.

2. Tell me about a time you had to deliver something on a deadline when someone on your team dropped the ball. What did you actually do?

3. Send me a link to a video ad, any video ad, that you think is badly made. Tell me specifically what is wrong with it. Be precise. Not it looks cheap, but what exactly breaks and why.

4. What tools have you used for managing work across a team? Trello, Asana, Notion, ClickUp, spreadsheets, anything.

5. When could you start, and what are your salary expectations?



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test on real work. You are paid for it whether or not I hire you.

title: Social Media Content Editor
description:
We are looking for a full-time short-form video editor with real experience creating content for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Content is in the entrepreneurial and agriculture niche. Personal branding experience is an asset, though not a requirement.



The correct candidate is someone who understands short form content creation - not just videos that look good, but videos that perform well because structure, pacing, and clip selection are understood and executed on.  



Our pages have over 450,000 followers/subscribers across platforms. 



What We Are Looking For

* Proven short-form social media experience. We want to see actual videos you have edited that generated meaningful views

* Experience in clipping long form videos into short form content. 

* Comfortable working with large volumes of content - from organization to identifying clips to structuring a short form video. 

* Strong understanding of hooks, retention, clip selection, pacing and viewer attention, particularly for videos under 30 seconds.

* Excellent judgment around tight pacing. Small editing decisions matter in short-form content.

* Ability to identify and recreate proven video styles and formats.

* Up to date on social media trends and able to identify trends that can be adapted to our original content.

* Performance-driven mindset. An editor must monitor the performance of the videos they create. It will be your responsibility to identify what is working and what is not - don’t wait for some else to guide you. 

* Ability to follow references closely. If a particular editing style or format is consistently generating millions of views, we do not need it redesigned or given a personal creative touch—we need it recreated accurately.

* Organized, reliable and able to handle consistent full-time content output.

* Independent and can take initiative. You will not always have someone to review and guide you - you must be comfortable taking ownership of the editing, producing final videos that are absent of careless mistakes. 

* Comfortable working with content scheduling platforms.



Important

This role is not just about technical editing, often times very basic styles have performed extremely well. Your understanding and intuition on hook and pacing is most important - knowing what to include, what to remove, how long each clip should stay on screen and when not to over-edit matters more than pure technical ability. 



Application Requirements

Please send:

* Resume

* Examples of short-form videos you personally edited. Emphasis is placed on relevant short form videos - polished highlight reels, real estate walk throughs, etc. generally do not provide evidence that you understand hooks, pacing, and clip selection for high performing social media content. 

* Links to the original posts showing their view counts where possible.

* Any accounts or pages you have regularly edited for.

* Your expected monthly salary for a full-time remote position.



Candidates who pass the initial screening will be asked to complete a paid editing test using our footage and reference videos.



This is a serious, long-term full-time position. We are willing to pay competitive compensation for someone who can demonstrate strong short-form editing ability and consistently contribute to content performance.

title: Business Systems & Operations Coordinator.
description:
BUSINESS SYSTEMS & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR



CRM | Automation | Operations



Remote | Philippines

Full Time | 40 hours per week

A$10 per hour

Long-term position



I’m the founder of an established Australian business operating across a busy hair salon, specialist hair loss clinic, professional hair education business and e-commerce.



The business has grown significantly and I’m looking for an exceptional Business Systems & Operations Coordinator to help organise, streamline and improve our backend operations across all areas of the business.



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL VA ROLE



I am not looking for someone who waits for me to give them a task list every morning.



I need someone who can come into the business, understand how things currently work, identify what’s inefficient and help create and implement better systems.



I want someone who naturally thinks:



“There has to be a better way to do this.”



Initially, you’ll work closely with me to understand the business. Over time, I want you to take real ownership of the backend so fewer things rely on the founder remembering, checking or following them up.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



SYSTEMS, PROCESSES & AUTOMATION



You’ll help us:



* Audit and clean up our current systems and processes

* Identify gaps, duplication and unnecessary manual work

* Design and implement better workflows

* Create and maintain SOPs

* Build useful trackers and dashboards

* Improve how information moves between platforms

* Identify opportunities for automation

* Build automations where appropriate

* Research and recommend better technology and solutions

* Continually look for ways to improve how the business operates



I don’t want to hand you a perfectly organised system. Helping us create that system is part of your job.



CRM & LEAD MANAGEMENT



One of your first major projects will be helping us create a centralised system for leads and enquiries across our salon, hair loss clinic and education business.



Leads currently enter through multiple channels and platforms.



I want someone who can assess our current setup and help determine:



* Where all our leads should live

* Which CRM or system best suits our business

* How different lead sources should connect

* How leads should be categorised

* How we track where each lead is in their journey

* How follow-ups happen consistently

* What should be automated

* What needs human contact

* How we track conversions and opportunities

* How we make sure nobody falls through the cracks



I am not looking for someone who needs me to choose the CRM for them.



I want someone with experience using different CRM systems who can understand our requirements, research the options and recommend what will work best.



Experience personally setting up, implementing or restructuring a CRM or lead-management system is highly desirable.



CLIENT JOURNEYS



You’ll help us map, build and improve our complete client journeys, particularly across our hair salon and specialist hair loss clinic.



This means looking at the experience from:



Lead → Enquiry → Booking → Forms/Information → Consultation/Service → Follow-Up → Ongoing Client Relationship



You’ll help determine:



* What should happen at every stage

* What information needs to be collected

* Where that information should live

* What communication should happen and when

* What should be automated

* What should remain personal

* How enquiries and quotes are followed up

* How we improve rebooking and retention

* What internal tasks need to be triggered

* How we ensure no client is forgotten



Our hair loss clinic in particular works with clients who may be going through an emotional or vulnerable experience.



Human touch is extremely important to us.



I do not want everything automated simply because it can be.



I want technology to remove unnecessary administration while allowing our team to provide an even better and more personal client experience.



PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION & STUDENT JOURNEY



We also operate a professional hair education business.



You’ll help organise and improve the student journey from:



Lead → Enquiry → Sale → Payment → Onboarding → Training → Post-Training Support → Ongoing Relationship



This may include:



* Education lead management and follow-up

* Student onboarding

* Course access

* Pre-training communication

* Forms and information

* Training reminders

* Post-training follow-up

* Student engagement

* Maintaining organised student records

* Ongoing
 communication and nurture

* Identifying students who may need support

* Future education opportunities



The goal is to create an exceptional student experience without the founder personally having to remember every next step.



ORDER MANAGEMENT



You’ll eventually take operational ownership of an important ordering process within our education business.



This includes:



* Receiving and checking orders

* Ensuring required information has been supplied

* Following up missing information

* Maintaining a central order tracker

* Coordinating with suppliers and agents

* Monitoring order progress

* Keeping students/customers updated

* Payment and order administration

* Tracking shipping

* Escalating technical decisions when specialist input is required



You’ll also be expected to improve and systemise this process, not simply operate it.



, EDMs & CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION



Excellent written English is essential because you’ll communicate directly with our clients, students and leads.



You’ll help with:



* Managing and organising inboxes

* Responding to enquiries

* Following up leads

* Client and student communication

* Following up missing information

* Creating
 templates

* EDM campaigns

*
 segmentation and nurture

* Automated
 sequences

* Ensuring important enquiries aren’t missed

* Knowing when something needs to be escalated



Communication should always feel warm, professional and human.



E-COMMERCE & EDUCATION PLATFORMS



You’ll also help manage and organise the backend of our e-commerce and education platforms.



This may include:



* Products and orders

* Student/customer access

* Tags and segmentation

*
 sequences

* Updating resources

* Course organisation

* Customer workflows

* Basic reporting

* Troubleshooting

* Keeping platforms organised



OUR CURRENT SYSTEMS



We currently use:



Phorest | Trello | Typeform | Kajabi | Shopify | Microsoft/Outlook | Google Sheets | ChatGPT/AI



You do not need experience with every platform.



I care more about finding someone who understands systems, CRM, automation and operations and can confidently research, learn and recommend what will work best for our business.



Experience with CRM platforms, no-code automation, Zapier, Make, n8n, APIs, webhooks or similar technology would be highly regarded.



We do not currently have a large automation stack in place.



Part of your role will be helping us determine what we actually need rather than adding technology for the sake of it.



AI IS WELCOME



I am completely happy for you to use AI to work smarter, research solutions, improve workflows and assist with communication.



However:



AI should support your brain, not replace it.



I’m hiring your judgement, initiative and problem-solving ability.



Our clients and students should never feel like they’re communicating with a robot.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You are:



* Extremely organised and detail-focused

* Proactive and systems-minded

* Technically confident

* A natural problem solver

* Excellent in written English

* Comfortable communicating directly with customers

* Experienced with CRM and lead-management systems

* Quick to learn new technology

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable suggesting a better way of doing something

* Someone who takes genuine ownership



Previous experience within the hair, beauty, salon, clinic or professional education industry would be highly regarded, but is not essential.



Experience working within an appointment-based or high-touch client business would also be valuable.



More important to me is that you have the systems brain and initiative to understand our business and improve how it operates.



Most importantly, I don’t want to manage your brain for you.



I want someone who will eventually come to me and say:



“I’ve noticed we’re doing this manually every week. I’ve looked into it and I think we can improve it this way.”



If you prefer receiving a task list every morning and simply completing exactly what you’ve been given, this probably isn’t the right role.



If you love taking messy processes and turning them into organised, scalable systems, I’d love to hear from you.



HOURS & PAY



40 hours per week

A$10 per hour

Remote | Philippines

Long-term position



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction

Tell me about yourself, your experience and why you think you’re suited to this role.



2. A 2–3 minute Loom video

Introduce yourself and tell me about your relevant experience. Please don’t heavily script it. I’d like to get a feel for how you communicate and think.



3. Show me something you’ve improved

Tell me about one system, workflow, CRM or automation that you personally created or significantly improved.



What was happening before? What did you change? What was the result?



4. Tell me about your CRM experience

Have you personally helped select, set up, implement or restructure a CRM or central lead-management system? What did you do and why?



5. Show me your initiative

Tell me about a time you noticed an inefficient process without being asked and what you did about it.



6. Tell me your technology experience

Which CRM platforms, systems and automation tools are you genuinely confident using?



7. Confirm your availability

Please confirm that you’re available for a full-time 40-hour-per-week position.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid trial task before final interviews.



IMPORTANT



Please begin your application with the words:



SYSTEMS FIRST



This is simply so I know you’ve taken the time to read the full job description.



Applications that do not begin with SYSTEMS FIRST will not be considered.

title: Short Term Rental Revenue & Pricing Specialist
description:
Short-Term Rental Revenue & Pricing Specialist



We’re a growing short-term rental management company managing properties across multiple U.S. markets. I’m looking for someone to help manage pricing strategy and revenue performance across our portfolio.



This is not just a data-entry role. I need someone who understands short-term rental demand, booking pace, seasonality, comparable listings, and how to use PriceLabs strategically.



Responsibilities:



* Manage and optimize pricing in PriceLabs

* Adjust minimum stays, last-minute pricing, gap-night rules, and booking-window strategy

* Help with light listing optimization, including titles, photo order, descriptions, and overall positioning

Ideal candidate:

* Strong PriceLabs experience

* Understands ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, booking lead time, seasonality, and comp sets

2. Your experience with PriceLabs

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About the Role

Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory. They are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the day to day accuracy of their financial records — transaction processing, coding, reconciliation, and the disciplined execution of the payables, receivables, and payroll cycles.



This role carries more weight than the title usually implies. Most bookkeeping roles are volume roles. This one is a judgment role with volume attached. Multi-phase engagements bill on milestones, subcontractor invoices have to be matched against agreed rates before anything moves, and expense submissions get checked against policy rather than waved through. The hard part is not entering the transaction, it is knowing where it belongs and saying so when you are not sure.



Expect 25 to 30 hours a week during onboarding and training, settling to around 20 once you are running the cycle independently. Hours grow from there: transaction volume is rising, the second company is just launching, and the more of the repetitive work you systematise and take on, the faster the role moves toward full time.



You would support two companies under the same ownership. The second is newly launching as an extension of the services the first provides, which means you will be setting up its finance processes rather than inheriting them, and keeping the records for the two entities cleanly separated as it grows.



Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no finance department behind you. You will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between, and the volume of transactions is rising as both companies grow. Priorities move and several things run at once, but the finance cycle still has to close on time and correctly every month. Holding both of those at once is the job.



The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets,
 threads, and automations with custom software. A meaningful part of this role is learning how the finance processes work today, documenting them properly, and automating the parts that should not need a person at all. We want someone who reaches for a system before they reach for a repetitive workaround.



What You'll Own



Accounts Payable and Contractor Payment



Process vendor bills daily, coding each to the correct account, customer, class, and billable flag in QuickBooks Online

Match subcontractor invoices against project records, agreed rates, and time tracking before anything is queued for payment

Review contractor expense submissions against the travel and expense policy, and flag exceptions rather than processing them

Prepare the semi-monthly payment run and produce the run summary for approval

Maintain vendor records, W-9s, and the onboarding documentation set



Billing and Accounts Receivable



Run the monthly invoicing cycle from time tracking into QuickBooks, ensuring every completed engagement is billed accurately and completely, including recoverable expenses

Apply milestone and deposit billing terms correctly for multi-phase engagements

Maintain the collections log on a weekly cycle: refresh status, issue past-due notices, and track follow-up dates

Report debtor ageing and escalate anything past the defined threshold rather than carrying it quietly



Reconciliation and Record Integrity



Perform monthly bank, credit card, and inter-system reconciliations on the defined cycle

Investigate and resolve reconciling items rather than carrying them forward

Maintain expense categorization consistency and flag coding that does not fit the existing chart of accounts

Prepare the month-end close file and supporting schedules for review



Payroll and Statutory Support



Own the payroll change cycle: enter approved new hires, approved terminations, and approved rate or salary changes into the payroll system

Verify that every approved change has been entered before the cutoff, and prepare the payroll change summary for review

Prepare the monthly payroll run, ensuring deductions, classifications, and filings are correct and on time. (Approval of the underlying changes, review of the change report, and final approval and submission of payroll all sit with the Managing Director.)

Maintain a clean distinction between payroll and contractor payment per engagement classification

Prepare annual contractor tax forms

Assemble the underlying numbers for state tax filings, workers' compensation premium audits, and annual insurance renewals



You prepare and support these. You do not own the filing decision or the external relationships.



Systems, Documentation and Automation



Run each finance process manually and correctly before proposing to change it

Write and update the procedure for every recurring task you own, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong

Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive, rules-based work, and store them in a form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform

Quality check automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct

Support the migration of finance data and workflows into the new operating platform, and own the approval steps it routes to a person

Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it

Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed



What You Bring



Six or more years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in a professional or technical services environment

Demonstrable QuickBooks Online experience: coding, reconciling, invoicing, and closing. Not familiarity — this has been your actual job.

Accuracy under volume, and the discipline to resolve a reconciling item rather than carry it

The judgment to reason about where a transaction belongs, and the honesty to say "I am not sure about this one" instead of guessing

Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to describe a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you verify the output.

Experience building or maintaining a workflow or automation in any tool, or clear evidence you look for the systemic fix rather than repeating the workaround

Strong written English

Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly



Strong advantages



CPA, or an equivalent national professional accountancy qualification

A degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

Experience maintaining books for more than one entity under common ownership

Experience with time tracking systems, relational database tools, expense and card management platforms, payroll providers, or workflow automation platforms

Experience through a finance system migration or accounting software implementation

Exposure to a regulated, audited, or ISO-certified environment

Experience supporting a US-based firm



How Success Is Measured



100% of completed engagements invoiced within the defined period

Debtor days within agreed target

100% of reconciliations completed on cycle, with no unresolved items carried forward

Month-end close file delivered within the agreed timetable

Zero payments released against unmatched or unverified documentation

Coding accuracy verified on review sample

A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left

Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow

Both entities closed cleanly and separately, with no cross-coding between them

Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly



How to Apply

Complete our application form here: 



It takes about ten minutes. To confirm you have read this posting in full, include the code BK-2026-READ where the application asks for it. We will respond to every applicant who completes the form.

title: Medical Front Desk Receptionist / Patient Coordinator — English & Spanish required - US Cardiology & Vein Practice
description:
About the role



We are a US cardiology, vein and vascular practice. You will be the first voice our patients hear. Most of them are older, many are anxious about a heart or vascular problem, and some are calling about bills they are worried about. How you speak to them matters more than anything else in this job.



You will not be reading from a script. You will be working inside our electronic health record all shift — confirming appointments, checking insurance, taking payments, managing the schedule and clearing the message queue before you log off.



What you will do

Phones and patient service

Answer inbound calls promptly and keep the queue clear; call back anyone who drops off

Greet every patient warmly, verify their identity with two identifiers before discussing anything

Keep patients informed when a provider is running late



Scheduling

Confirm appointments, state any balance owed, and document the outcome in the EHR

Check whether the patient's insurance requires a referral and that a current one is on file

Keep every provider's schedule full — we work three business days ahead and no slots should be open for the next day

Spot problems on the schedule a week out and fix them

Call no-shows within one business day



Check-in and records

Send intake, financial, HIPAA and consent forms through the patient portal ahead of the visit and chase the ones not completed

Verify address, date of birth and insurance against the record on every visit — read it back, never accept "nothing has changed"

Upload new insurance cards and IDs the same day



Telehealth

Send visit links, confirm the telemedicine consent is signed, and help patients who are struggling to connect



Payments

Collect copays, deductibles and balances by card-on-file or secure payment link, and post them the same day

Reconcile the daily payment log and send it to our Billing Manager before you log off



End of shift



Clear every message, portal reply and telephone encounter — nothing sits overnight

Prepare the next day's schedules and flag balances and missing paperwork

What we need from you



Required



Excellent spoken English and Spanish, clear and easy for an older American patient to understand on the phone

At least 3 years in a US medical front desk, patient coordinator, or medical answering service role

Working knowledge of US insurance basics: copay, deductible, referral, authorization, Medicare

Comfortable with medical terminology

Strong written English and Spanish for portal messages and internal notes

Accurate typing and genuine attention to detail — you will be entering data that affects whether a claim gets paid

Able to work independently at night without someone looking over your shoulder, and to speak up early when something is wrong



Nice to have

eClinicalWorks or Athena experience

Cardiology, vein or vascular practice experience

Previous HIPAA training



Home office requirements

Fiber internet, 50 Mbps or better, plus a backup connection (second ISP or mobile data) — you cannot be offline during a US business day

UPS or backup power for brownouts

A private room where patient calls cannot be overheard by anyone in your household. This is a HIPAA requirement and it is not negotiable.

Own computer (Windows 10/11, 8 GB RAM minimum), noise-cancelling headset, webcam

You will sign a confidentiality agreement and complete HIPAA training before you get system access



How to apply

Applications that ignore these steps will not be read.



Start your message with the word PULSE so we know you read the whole post.

Tell us in a few sentences about a difficult or upset patient you handled, and what you said to them.

Tell us which EHR systems you have used and for how long.

Confirm you can work 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT long term, and tell us your internet speed and backup plan.

Record a 60-second voice message in English introducing yourself and explaining how you would tell a patient their doctor is running 45 minutes behind. Attach it or send a link. We will not shortlist anyone without a voice sample.



Our process: shortlist → short written exercise → video interview → paid test shift → offer.



We are looking for someone to stay with us for years, not months. 



If that is what you want too, we would like to hear from you.

title: Ecom Automation Expert and Controller (Social Media, Crossposting, AI Video Creation, Creative Briefs)
description:
# Job Offer: Senior AI Social Automation Architect



### Build the operating system behind a multi-market AI content network



We are building a next-generation organic social commerce engine across multiple European markets.



This is not a social media manager role.



This is not a “make a few automations in 
” role.



We are looking for someone who can architect, build and continuously improve an AI-native system that turns:



**Product → Audience → Pain Point → Content Idea → Script → Video → Localisation → Publishing → Engagement → Funnel → Revenue → Learning**



into a scalable automated workflow.



Our initial focus is Finland, Sweden, Poland, Netherlands and Belgium, with more markets to follow.



The long-term goal is to operate dozens — potentially hundreds — of localised social accounts across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and
.



---



## Your Mission



Build the infrastructure that allows us to launch and operate social brands at scale.



A typical setup may look like:



**3 markets × 3 accounts × 3 posts per day**



That already means:



**27 localised videos per day**



Across multiple platforms, this quickly becomes thousands of monthly content placements.



Your job is to make that scalable, measurable and increasingly autonomous.



---



# What You Will Build



You will design the entire automation layer connecting AI models, APIs, databases, social platforms, video-generation tools and analytics systems.



A typical workflow might look like:



**Market / Product / Persona**



→ Pain Point Research

→ Content Angle

→ Hook Generation

→ Script

→ Localisation

→ Avatar / Creator

→ Voice

→ B-roll / AI Video

→ Automated Editing

→ Captions

→ QA

→ Publishing

→ Engagement

→ Analytics

→ Funnel Revenue

→ Performance Feedback Loop



The system should become smarter over time based on what actually performs.



---



# The Content Engine



We do not want generic AI scripts.



The system needs to understand:



### Pain



What keeps the target audience frustrated?



### Desire



What do they actually want their life to look like?



### Identity



Who do they want to become?



### Transformation



What change are they hoping to experience?



For example, a 60+ wellness account is not really selling:



**protein, supplements or recipes.**



It may be selling:



**energy, confidence, attractiveness, independence, longevity and the feeling of still being fully alive at 60+.**



The scripting system needs to understand that distinction.



---



# Content Formats



You will help create automated pipelines for formats such as:



* Lifestyle creators

* Wellness creators

* Fitness 50+

* Healthy ageing

* Beauty

* Recipes

* Nutrition

* Biohacking

* Educational content

* Product education

* Storytelling

* UGC-style content

* Animated / 3D characters

* AI hosts

* Real creator digital twins

* Faceless accounts



The objective is not overly polished AI content.



The objective is:



**Believable. Native. Emotional. Interesting. Consistent.**



Sometimes an imperfect-looking smartphone-style video will outperform a visually perfect AI commercial.



You need to understand that.



---



# AI Avatar Infrastructure



A major part of the role will involve creating consistent digital creators.



For example:



A female wellness creator in her 60s.



The character needs consistency across:



* Face

* Body

* Age

* Hair

* Voice

* Clothing

* Personality

* Environment

* Communication style



She should look like the same creator after 300 videos.



The same applies to animated characters and educational personalities.



Where fictional or AI-generated creators are used, the system should follow applicable platform disclosure and advertising requirements rather than relying on deceptive impersonation.



---



# Localisation



We are not interested in simply translating English scripts.



Each market should feel native.



The system should handle:



**Master Concept**



→ Finnish

→ Swedish

→ Polish

→ Dutch

→ Flemish

→ Future markets



Localisation may include:



* Native phrasing

* Local cultural references

* Localised hooks

* Local voices

* Local products

* Local pricing

* Local currencies

* Local landing pages

* Local CTAs

* Market-specific pain points

* Different creative styles



We want:



**Central strategy. Local execution.**



---



# Competitive Intelligence



We want systems that continuously analyse successful public social content in our niches.



The objective is not to copy creators.



The objective is to understand patterns.



For example:



Analyse hundreds of high-performing videos.



Extract:



* Hooks

* Topics

* Video structures

* Pain points

* Story formats

* First frames

* Video lengths

* Captions

* CTAs

* Comments

* Audience questions

* Emerging trends



Then cluster these into strategic insights.



Example:



**500 videos**



→ transcription

→ classification

→ hook analysis

→ pain-point clustering

→ engagement analysis

→ original strategy generation



Tools may include:



* Apify

* platform APIs

* social intelligence software

* transcription tools

* LLMs

* custom scrapers where permitted

* databases

* internal dashboards



---



# Automation Stack



We do not care which tool is fashionable.



We care about:



**Quality × Cost × Reliability × Speed × Scalability**



Potential technologies may include:



### Automation



* n8n

* Make

* custom workflows

* event-driven services



### AI



* Claude

* Gemini

* OpenAI models

* specialised models



### Video



* Higgsfield

* Veo

* Kling

* Runway

* HeyGen

* emerging video models



### Images



* Gemini Image

* Flux

* specialised character models



### Voice



* ElevenLabs

* other high-quality multilingual TTS



### Rendering



* Creatomate

* Remotion

* FFmpeg

* Shotstack



### Internal Tools



* Base44

* Supabase

* PostgreSQL

* custom dashboards



### Distribution



* Metricool

* Ayrshare

* 

* official platform APIs



### Agent Infrastructure



* MCP

* Claude Code

* custom agents

* API orchestration



You should continuously test whether something better has appeared.



---



# We Want Agents, Not Just Workflows



Eventually, we want to issue instructions such as:



**“Prepare tomorrow's three videos for the Finnish wellness account.”**



The system should then:



1. Review previous performance.

2. Find winning themes.

3. Select pain points.

4. Select content angles.

5. Generate scripts.

6. Localise them.

7. Generate assets.

8. Create voice.

9. Assemble the videos.

10. Run QA.

11. Queue the content.

12. Publish.

13. Collect performance data.

14. Update the content database.



Humans should increasingly manage exceptions and strategy instead of manually moving files between tools.



---



# Publishing Infrastructure



You will build reliable distribution across:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts



The system should account for platform-specific requirements such as:



* Video length

* Captions

* Titles

* Descriptions

* Cover frames

* Subtitle positioning

* Safe zones

* CTAs

* Posting schedules

* Aspect ratios

* Content formatting



One video does not necessarily mean one identical upload everywhere.



---



# Engagement Automation



You will also investigate intelligent engagement workflows.



For example:



**New comment**



→ understand intent

→ classify comment

→ generate appropriate response

→ automatically answer suitable FAQs

→ escalate sensitive comments

→ identify buying intent

→ identify customer-service issues



The goal is to assist genuine account engagement at scale, not create spam or fake engagement.



---



# Account Management



As we scale, we need a control centre for the entire network.



Every account should have structured information such as:



* Market

* Language

* Persona

* Product

* Funnel

* Platform

* Posting status

* Last post

* Next post

* Account owner

* Performance

* Funnel clicks

* Revenue

* Errors

* Automation status



We may operate accounts through dedicated devices or managed mobile infrastructure where appropriate.



The objective is stable, secure multi-account operations — not bypassing platform enforcement systems.



---



# Automated QA



The system needs to catch bad content before it goes live.



Examples:



* Broken subtitles

* Wrong language

* Wrong CTA

* Wrong landing page

* Broken lip sync

* Character inconsistency

* Strange AI artefacts

* Incorrect product

* Unsupported health claims

* Duplicate content

* Failed rendering

* Incorrect currency

* Watermarks

* Audio problems

* Incorrect aspect ratio



You should design automated checks wherever possible.



---



# Health & Supplement Content



Some of our products may involve health, wellness and supplements.



This requires stronger QA.



The content engine should work from approved claims and approved product information rather than allowing models to invent medical or health promises.



The automation architecture needs to support this.



---



# Performance Feedback Loop



This is one of the most important parts of the job.



Every video should become structured data.



Example:



**Market:** Poland

**Persona:** Women 55+

**Pain:** Low Energy

**Angle:** Identity

**Hook:** 07

**Format:** Lifestyle Story

**Product:** X



Performance:



* Views

* Retention

* Completion rate

* Saves

* Shares

* Comments

* Profile visits

* Link clicks

* Purchases

* Revenue



The system should eventually identify:



> “Identity-based hooks about energy significantly outperform educational hooks for this persona in Poland.”



Then create more content around that pattern.



Our competitive advantage should eventually become our own dataset.



---



# We Care About Revenue



Follower count is useful.



Views are useful.



But they are not the final objective.



We care about:



### Revenue per 1,000 views



### Funnel CTR



### Revenue per account



### Revenue per content angle



### Revenue per persona



### Revenue per market



### Customer acquisition economics



The infrastructure needs to connect social performance to commercial performance.



---



# Your Daily Responsibilities



You will monitor and improve the machine every day.



This includes:



* Check failed workflows

* Check failed uploads

* Check API issues

* Review AI output

* Review account health

* Monitor content quality

* Monitor generation costs

* Monitor localisation quality

* Review analytics

* Improve prompts

* Improve scripts

* Test new tools

* Test new models

* Reduce unnecessary costs

* Improve speed

* Reduce manual intervention

* Fix edge cases

* Improve dashboards



You are responsible for the **system**, not merely individual automations.



---



# Weekly Responsibilities



Every week we expect a short operating review.



### What worked?



Which:



* Hooks

* Markets

* Personas

* Formats

* Products

* Characters

* Angles



performed best?



### What failed?



What broke?



Why?



### What can be automated next?



Where are humans still wasting time?



### What changed in AI?



What new model or tool should we test?



### Where can costs drop?



Can we achieve the same output for 30% less?



### What do we test next week?



There should always be an experimentation roadmap.



---



# Ideal Candidate



You are probably someone who already spends too much time experimenting with new AI tools.



You should be comfortable with:



* n8n

* APIs

* REST

* Webhooks

* MCP

* OAuth

* JSON

* JavaScript

* Python

* Databases

* SQL

* LLMs

* Prompt systems

* AI video

* AI images

* AI voices

* Browser automation

* Social APIs

* Cloud services

* FFmpeg / rendering workflows

* Debugging

* Analytics



You do not have to be a hardcore backend engineer.



But you need to be extremely good at **making software work together.**



---



# We Are NOT Looking For



Someone whose entire automation skill set is:



**ChatGPT → 
 → Google Sheet.**



Someone who recommends tools without understanding API limitations.



Someone who builds workflows that work once and break every third day.



Someone obsessed with AI quality while ignoring generation cost.



Someone who understands automation but has zero understanding of marketing.



Someone who celebrates views without asking whether they generated sales.



---



# You Think Like an Operator



When you see repetitive work:



> “Why are we doing this manually?”



When you see an expensive model:



> “Does the performance justify the cost?”



When you see a new AI tool:



> “Can I test this against what we're currently using?”



When something breaks:



> “How do I make sure this failure can never happen silently again?”



When content performs:



> “What caused it, and how can we systematically reproduce it?”



---



# First 30 Days



Your first assignment is to build the V1 operating system.



### Initial target



**3 countries**



×



**3 accounts per country**



×



**3 posts per account/day**



=



## 27 localised videos per day



The first version should automate as much as possible of:



1. Research

2. Pain-point collection

3. Content ideation

4. Hook generation

5. Script generation

6. Localisation

7. Voice generation

8. Avatar/content generation

9. B-roll

10. Editing

11. Subtitles

12. QA

13. Publishing

14. Analytics collection

15. Performance storage



---



# 60-Day Goal



By Day 60:



* Significantly less manual work

* Stable content pipeline

* Reliable publishing

* Centralised dashboard

* Better creative consistency

* Automated performance collection

* Basic winner identification

* Automated content variation

* Clear production economics



---



# 90-Day Goal



By Day 90, we want to move toward:



**Product + Market + Persona**



### IN



↓



Research

Scripts

Creative

Localisation

Publishing

Analytics



↓



### CONTENT ENGINE OUT



The team should mainly focus on:



**Products, strategy, creative direction and scaling.**



Not moving files between SaaS tools.



---



# What Success Looks Like



The best person in this role will eventually be able to say:



> “We launched three new countries this week without adding another employee.”



That is the standard.



---



# Why This Role Is Interesting



You will not be maintaining a boring internal automation.



You will be building an infrastructure where:



**AI + Content + E-commerce + Automation + Data**



all meet.



You will have significant freedom to choose the technology.



If a better model launches tomorrow, we want to know.



If a workflow can be replaced with an agent, test it.



If we can eliminate a SaaS subscription with a small internal tool, build it.



If a €500/month tool produces €20,000/month of additional output, use it.



We want someone who thinks commercially, not dogmatically.



---



# Application



Do not send us a generic CV only.



Show us what you can build.



Please send:



**1. Your strongest automation project**



Explain what it did and how the architecture worked.



**2. Your current preferred AI content stack**



What would you use today for:



* scripting

* localisation

* image generation

* video generation

* avatars

* voices

* editing

* publishing

* analytics



And why.



**3. Architecture Challenge**



Explain how you would build:



> **3 markets × 3 accounts × 3 videos/day across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts.**



We want to understand:



* Architecture

* Software

* APIs

* Database

* Estimated monthly costs

* Failure handling

* How you would keep characters consistent

* How you would collect performance data

* How you would improve the system over time



**4. Tell us what you would NOT automate.**



This question matters.



---



## Role



**Senior AI Social Automation Architect / AI Growth Systems Engineer**



**Remote**



**Long-term**



**High ownership**



Compensation depends on experience and demonstrated ability.



For the right person, this is not a small freelance automation project.



**You will own the technology layer of a system we intend to scale across markets, products and potentially hundreds of social channels.**

title: Screen Recording Tutorial Creator — Long-Term, Part-Time
description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to create simple 2-minute “How-To” tutorial videos. You will record your screen while demonstrating each task and explain what you are doing with clear, natural English narration. There is no need to show your face, create animations, or do heavy video editing. This is a long-term position for someone who can consistently complete the weekly workload.

What You'll Do

- Receive a daily or weekly list of tutorial topics and required keywords.

- Follow the provided instructions and reference examples.

- Record your screen while completing the required task.

- Explain each step naturally as you perform it.

- Record tutorials on PC or mobile depending on the topic.

- Make sure your mouse clicks and actions match your narration.

- Keep videos clear, simple, and easy to follow.

- Make basic corrections when necessary.

- Upload completed videos to our shared Google Drive folder.

- Follow our SOPs and instructions carefully.

At first, you'll need to perform each step carefully. Once you become familiar with the workflow, most tutorials should be possible to complete in one continuous recording.

Workload

Approximately 20–30 videos per week, usually 4–6 videos per day, 5 days per week.

Most videos will be around 2 minutes long.

Once you learn the workflow, each video should generally take around 3–5 minutes to record, depending on the topic.

Requirements

- Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation.

- Natural and understandable voice. No robotic or monotone delivery.

- Comfortable using computers, browsers, software, and settings.

- Good attention to detail.

- Able to follow step-by-step instructions accurately.

- Reliable PC/laptop capable of running screen-recording software.

- Decent microphone or headset.

- Stable internet connection.

- A reasonably quiet environment for recording.

- Reliable and consistent with deadlines.

Experience with OBS, Loom, Camtasia, CapCut, or similar software is a plus, but previous experience is not required if you are comfortable learning.

Compensation

Base Pay: $60/week

Additional performance bonuses of up to $30/week may be available based on:

- High-quality and accurate recordings

- Consistent on-time delivery

- Completing the expected workload

- Following SOPs correctly

- Good communication and reliability

- Proactively identifying and fixing workflow issues

Total potential earnings: up to $90/week.

Payments are made weekly via PayPal or Wise.

Why Work With Us?

- Long-term position with consistent weekly work.

- Flexible working hours as long as deadlines are met.

- Clear instructions, SOPs, and reference videos provided.

- Simple and repeatable workflow.

- Regular feedback.

- Opportunity for reliable high performers to take on additional responsibilities and higher-paying work.

How to Apply

To confirm that you have read the entire job post, start your application with: SCREENPRO25

Then include:

1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A 30-second voice sample (MP3 or link) saying:

      “Hi, my name is [Your Name]. I’m comfortable with tech tutorials and I can follow step-by-step instructions carefully.”

3. Your PC/laptop specifications.

4. Your experience with screen recording, if any.

5. Which screen-recording software you currently use, if any.

6. Your available working hours.

7. Confirmation that you understand the $60 base + potential $30 performance bonus structure.

Please be honest about your experience. Previous screen-recording experience is helpful, but beginners who are comfortable with technology are welcome to apply.

Trial Task



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial task consisting of 3 sample videos.

The trial will help us evaluate:

- Voice clarity

- Recording quality

- Ability to follow instructions

- Accuracy of clicks and narration

- Attention to detail

- Overall suitability for the role

If the trial goes well, we can move forward with ongoing weekly work.

We are looking for someone dependable who wants to work with us for the long term.

title: Cross-Channel Marketing, SEO & AI Automation Manager
description:
About the Role



We are an international digital marketing and technology agency working with clients across different countries and industries.



We are looking for a proactive Cross-Channel Marketing, SEO & AI Automation Manager to join our team on a full-time, long-term basis.



This is a hands-on role combining SEO, AEO/GEO, content, social media, lead generation, video, analytics and AI automation.



A key part of the role is improving client visibility across traditional search and increasingly AI-powered search environments, while also supporting wider cross-channel marketing activities.



We are looking for someone who understands the business objective, takes ownership and turns opportunities into practical actions.



Key Responsibilities



• Develop and improve SEO, Local SEO, AEO/GEO and AI Search strategies.

• Conduct keyword, competitor, search intent and content opportunity research.

• Optimise website content, landing pages, metadata, internal linking and on-page SEO.

• Identify opportunities to improve visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other search environments.

• Plan and coordinate cross-channel marketing activities across websites, LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

• Create and improve website copy, articles, captions, hooks, headlines and marketing content.

• Support lead generation, landing pages, campaigns and conversion opportunities.

• Create or coordinate social media content, graphics, carousels and other assets.

• Edit short-form and longer-form video where required.

• Monitor performance using GA4, Google Search Console and platform analytics.

• Turn performance data into clear recommendations and actions.

• Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools for research, content, analysis and productivity.

• Build or support practical automations using n8n, Make, Zapier or similar tools.

• Automate areas such as research, content repurposing, reporting, lead collection and repetitive marketing tasks.

• Coordinate with developers, designers and other team members.



What We Are Looking For



• 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, SEO, content or social media.

• Strong understanding of digital and cross-channel marketing.

• Good knowledge of SEO and on-page optimisation.

• Understanding of AEO, GEO and AI Search is highly valuable.

• Experience with social media management and content creation.

• Good understanding of lead generation and conversion-focused marketing.

• Strong written English.

• Experience with Canva or similar creative tools.

• Video editing experience using CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or similar.

• Strong practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

• Some experience with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation tools.

• Strong organisation, ownership and ability to manage several priorities.



Experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, Google Business Profile, YouTube optimisation, Google Ads, Meta Ads, APIs, structured data, AI agents or CRM integrations is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



How We Work



We are looking for someone who:



• understands the objective behind the task;

• takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions;

• combines analytical thinking with creative judgement;

• can think across different marketing channels;

title: Call Centre Sales Manager
description:
We're looking for a sales manager to run our appointment setting team. You'll own the hiring, the training, and the day-to-day management of the appointment setters who book appointments for our medical spa clinics in the United States. The person we want makes decisions from the numbers. 



Not from how the team feels, not from what someone said in a meeting — from the data. You should be the kind of manager who opens the report before you open Slack, and who can tell me which setter is slipping before they tell you.



You also need to have actually sold. Not customer service — selling. Carrying a target on the phone, handling objections, closing. You cannot coach what you have never done.



Apply here: 



What you'll be responsible for



- Leading and managing the team. Our setters call warm inbound leads — women who have already filled in a form asking about a treatment — and book them into the clinic's calendar with a paid deposit. Nobody here cold calls. Your job is that they hit their numbers. 



- Team performance monitoring. Reviewing clinic and team numbers every day, and basing your training and your management decisions on what those numbers say.



- Scripting. Building the call scripts for each clinic's promotion, written to book appointments with a deposit attached. Your setters read what you write.



- Quality assurance. Making sure the team stays on script, with the right tonality and a conversational flow. One call review per setter, per day.



- Process improvement. Continually optimising how we run as the company grows, and bringing in new technology and new methods as they become available.



- Reporting and analysis. Making sure every setter files their end-of-day report, checking those reports against the actual call data, and reporting up.



Requirements



- Experience. Minimum 3 years managing teams in a call center environment, ideally in sales or digital marketing. A genuine sales background. Outbound, target-carrying, objection-handling sales. Inbound customer support experience is not a substitute — please don't apply on the strength of it.



- Analytical thinking. You can read a set of numbers, find the trend, and turn it into a decision. This is the single thing we'll test hardest.



- Accountability. You've held people to expectations and KPIs. You've had the difficult conversation, put someone on a plan, and let someone go when it didn't work. A manager who avoids conflict cannot do this job, however well liked they are.



- Coaching. A track record of taking a weak performer and making them good. Be ready to name a specific person, what was wrong, and what their numbers went from and to.



- Technical ability. Comfortable with call center and CRM software, dialers, programmable SMS, and project management tools. Experience with AI or chatbot integration is a strong plus.



- Detail. You'll be cross-checking end-of-day reports against real call data. Numbers that don't reconcile need to bother you.



- Communication. Fluent, native-level English, spoken and written. You'll be coaching calls made to American women — you need to hear tone and hesitation, not just words.



Pay & Hours



- $2,500 USD/Month + Performance Bonuses

- 40 hrs/week



Apply here:
