title: Logo Research and Vector Recreation Assistant — Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
We are looking for a careful graphic designer and research assistant to replace old, low-quality logo files with accurate, clean versions for a large online database.



This is accuracy and production work—not creative logo design.



## Responsibilities



* Identify the correct logo from the information provided.

* Search official websites, archived websites and other reliable sources for the best available version.

* Record the source URL for every logo found.

* Manually recreate low-resolution logos when no suitable vector version exists.

* Preserve the original shapes, typography, colours, spacing and proportions.

* Export files according to the required naming and formatting rules.

* Flag uncertain identities, unreadable text or conflicting versions instead of guessing.

* Maintain a spreadsheet showing the source and status of every logo.



## Required skills



* Strong Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, CorelDRAW or equivalent vector-editing experience.

* Proven experience with manual vector tracing and logo reconstruction.

* Good online research skills.

* Excellent attention to typography, spacing, curves and alignment.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions consistently.

* Good written English.

* Reliable communication and careful file organisation.



## Deliverables



For each approved logo:



* Editable SVG.

* Transparent PNG at the requested dimensions.

* Editable AI, EPS or equivalent source file.

* Clean vector paths without embedded low-resolution images.

* Correct file name.

* Source URL and a brief source note.



Logos must be exact reconstructions. Do not modernise, redesign, simplify or invent missing details. Do not use automatic tracing without carefully cleaning and checking the result. AI-generated approximations are not acceptable.



## Paid Test



Shortlisted candidates will receive the same paid test involving five logos of varying difficulty. The test will assess:



* Correct identification of each logo.

* Quality and reliability of the sources.

* Accuracy of typography, spacing and colours.

* Quality of the vector paths.

* File organisation and naming.

* Ability to recognise and report uncertainty.



Applicants who complete the test successfully may be offered regular part-time work involving a large collection of logos.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Examples of logos you have manually reconstructed from poor-quality images.

3. Before-and-after examples, if available.

4. The vector software you use.

5. Your preferred hourly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. A brief explanation of how you verify that you have found the correct logo.

8. The words **“Exact Logo Recreation”** at the beginning of your application.



Please do not apply if your portfolio consists mainly of Canva templates or automatically generated logos. We need someone who is patient, methodical and capable of producing accurate vector artwork.



Salary



US$5 per hour, initially for 10–20 hours per week. This is a long-term position for the right person. Hours and pay may increase after the initial trial period based on accuracy, reliability and productivity.



The five-logo selection test will be paid.

title: Customer Support Specialist for US-based tech company (Full Time)
description:
***IMPORTANT: Hi! My name is Atisha Patel, VP of Customer Success & Operations at Boom. To apply for this job, please fill out the application form: 



You can also reach me at 
 be working most closely with Joven Verano, our Customer Support Operations Team Manager, who is based in the Philippines and can be reached at 
 CC 
 on all
s.



COMPANY AND OPPORTUNITY 

Boom is building the agentic operational layer for the residential real estate industry. Property managers and landlords handle significant manual, but critical work that requires intelligence and accuracy: screening applicants, chasing income documents, reviewing reports, answering prospect calls, and often get the same questions a hundred times a week. We're replacing that with software and AI agents that do the work, and a human team that makes sure it's done right.

Our products include BoomScreen (tenant screening: identity verification, income verification, credit, criminal, eviction and rental history reports) and BoomCRM (leads, listings, and AI leasing agents), alongside BoomReport, our rent reporting product. We are a growing team led by top tier investors, a second-time founder CEO, and people with experience across real estate, consulting, and AI. We ship new features every day.



We're seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our support and operations team. This is a real customer support role -you'll be the person who figures out why an applicant's ID verification is stuck and get them to the finish line, walk a property manager through a screening template, and write up a bug ticket in Jira to help our engineers fix the issue when something is actually broken. You'll primarily be using our customer support platform, Fin (Formerly Intercom), Slack, Teams, and Google Chat, where you will support applicants, leads, and property managers with first-hand questions. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve how you support our customers, quickly and accurately, with empathy. Additionally, our chat is AI-first and escalates to humans, and part of your job is being the human who catches what the AI gets wrong. We're excited to have a work relationship where you learn from us as much as we learn from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO 

This role is roughly half consumer support and half business customer support, plus ad-hoc project work.

Supporting consumers (Leads, applicants, renters)

Help applicants get through the application itself - identity verification retries and failed uploads, income document submissions (bank statements, paystubs, W-2s), bank and payroll linking, application status questions

Explain next steps and respond to questions clearly and calmly, including sensitive topics like credit, criminal, and eviction records

Handle rent reporting questions (enrollment, verification timelines, credit bureau reporting)

Proactive outreach to applicants who are stuck mid-application, by chat,
, SMS, or phone

Repushing applications when needed, making data corrections (e.g. Name changes)

Supporting business customers (property managers and partners)

Help property managers set up the Boom platform: screening templates and criteria, roles and permissions, application management, running reports, etc.

Troubleshoot technical issues related to tenant screening - For example, when data is not syncing from Boom to a Property Manager’s database

Enter “Guest cards” as needed in the property management system when needed, transferring information from applications

Investigate issues in our admin tools and partner portal before escalating, and give partners a clear answer on what happened and what's next

Work in shared partner channels (Slack, Google Chat, Microsoft Teams) alongside our Customer Success Managers

Diagnosing and escalating bugs

Diagnose the problem immediately, resolve it yourself where you can, explain it in plain language to the customer, and create a well-documented ticket when it needs engineering. Think about how this can be improved moving forward.

A good ticket from you includes the issue, the customer, the relevant admin and portal links, the partner ID, and screenshots or recordings. We'll train you on our process and how to write tickets, and then expect to have you continue that quality

Know the difference between "this needs a bug ticket" and "this is a one-off request" — and know when not to file at all

Ad-hoc projects

Data gathering and research (vendor and competitor research, conference preparation, searching on various websites to understand which softwares are used, and light data analysis)

Data entry and bulk configuration work in our admin tools and partner portal

File creation and spreadsheet work (trackers, enrollment files, audit lists)

Reviewing applications and leads, app store and social review responses, and other one-off projects as they come up



REQUIREMENTS

Must have worked in a customer support role before. This is not an entry-level position

Near-native English, written and verbal. Our support includes chat,
, and voice, and you will be on the phone with US customers

Excellent communication skills. You can explain a technical problem in simple terms and explain exactly which steps you took, and well as expected verses current behavior.

Ability to diagnose, resolve, explain, and ticket technical problems. You investigate before you escalate, and you write up what you found

Ultra high responsiveness across many different communication channels. Our target is under 2 minutes on live chat, and you'll be moving between Intercom, Slack,
, phone, and partner channels all shift. If you go quiet, this role won't work

Comfortable using a support platform. We use Intercom (very similar to Zendesk) inbox, macros, tagging, help center articles

Comfortable working with AI tools. We use Claude in our support team, and you'll be reviewing and correcting AI-suggested responses, not just sending them

Attention to detail. Much of this work involves sensitive consumer data and regulated reports where accuracy matters

Open to change - processes and product change weekly at a startup, and you have to be comfortable with that

Unafraid to ask for help. We're happy to train you and help with problems, but going silent is unacceptable

Ability to work independently, organized, and good at time management

Fast, stable, reliable internet connection, and a quiet place to take calls

Computer specs of at least an Intel i5 processor (or equivalent AMD) and 8GB RAM

Experience with Fin, Google, Teams, and Slack is a plus



OUR TECH STACK INCLUDES

Fin (Intercom) — customer chat,
, SMS, help center, and our AI chat agent (

Slack / Zoom — internal communication

Google Workspace — Sheets, Docs, Gmail, Google Chat

Microsoft Teams Chat

Jira / Confluence — tickets and documentation

Claude — AI assistance & knowledge

Boom Admin and Partner Portal — our internal tools



TRAINING & TEAMING

We have a team of about 30 support team members in the Philippines, with Philippines-based team leads. You will not be figuring this out alone

Your first week in onboarding: tools setup, a full product overview across BoomScreen, BoomCRM, and BoomReport, our daily ops rhythm, and introductions from our leadership team. You'll also shadow experienced teammates on live queues before you own work yourself.

Ongoing training runs on recorded walkthroughs, written SOPs, and direct coaching from your team lead. Joven and our team leads run daily stand-ups and are available on Slack throughout your shift



WORKLOAD & DAYS/TIMES OF WORK

We'll start on a 1-month fully paid trial (we both see how we work together)

~45 hours per week to start

We staff support 7 days a week across multiple shifts, including overnight. Primary coverage is Monday - Friday, 10am - 7pm New York time, and we are also very interested in candidates who can cover overnight shifts and/or at least 1 day of weekend coverage. Tell us in your application what shifts you can commit to

Select US holidays are off; Christmas and New Year's Day are paid non-working days



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$4-5 per hour, with the opportunity to increase as you take on more responsibility

13th month bonus, prorated to the months and hours you've worked at Boom (e.g. if you've been at Boom less than a full year and/or are working less than 40 hours)

Payroll frequency: Every 2 weeks



HOW TO APPLY

Complete the application at this link: 

Applications through OnlineJobs will not be considered



If selected to move forward, you can expect a few short skill tests (a typing test, a quick written communication exercise, and a short research task) before an interview. They're designed to be quick and show us how you actually work, so will be recorded.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About the Role

Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory. They are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the day to day accuracy of their financial records — transaction processing, coding, reconciliation, and the disciplined execution of the payables, receivables, and payroll cycles.



This role carries more weight than the title usually implies. Most bookkeeping roles are volume roles. This one is a judgment role with volume attached. Multi-phase engagements bill on milestones, subcontractor invoices have to be matched against agreed rates before anything moves, and expense submissions get checked against policy rather than waved through. The hard part is not entering the transaction, it is knowing where it belongs and saying so when you are not sure.



Expect 25 to 30 hours a week during onboarding and training, settling to around 20 once you are running the cycle independently. Hours grow from there: transaction volume is rising, the second company is just launching, and the more of the repetitive work you systematise and take on, the faster the role moves toward full time.



You would support two companies under the same ownership. The second is newly launching as an extension of the services the first provides, which means you will be setting up its finance processes rather than inheriting them, and keeping the records for the two entities cleanly separated as it grows.



Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no finance department behind you. You will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between, and the volume of transactions is rising as both companies grow. Priorities move and several things run at once, but the finance cycle still has to close on time and correctly every month. Holding both of those at once is the job.



The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets,
 threads, and automations with custom software. A meaningful part of this role is learning how the finance processes work today, documenting them properly, and automating the parts that should not need a person at all. We want someone who reaches for a system before they reach for a repetitive workaround.



What You'll Own



Accounts Payable and Contractor Payment



Process vendor bills daily, coding each to the correct account, customer, class, and billable flag in QuickBooks Online

Match subcontractor invoices against project records, agreed rates, and time tracking before anything is queued for payment

Review contractor expense submissions against the travel and expense policy, and flag exceptions rather than processing them

Prepare the semi-monthly payment run and produce the run summary for approval

Maintain vendor records, W-9s, and the onboarding documentation set



Billing and Accounts Receivable



Run the monthly invoicing cycle from time tracking into QuickBooks, ensuring every completed engagement is billed accurately and completely, including recoverable expenses

Apply milestone and deposit billing terms correctly for multi-phase engagements

Maintain the collections log on a weekly cycle: refresh status, issue past-due notices, and track follow-up dates

Report debtor ageing and escalate anything past the defined threshold rather than carrying it quietly



Reconciliation and Record Integrity



Perform monthly bank, credit card, and inter-system reconciliations on the defined cycle

Investigate and resolve reconciling items rather than carrying them forward

Maintain expense categorization consistency and flag coding that does not fit the existing chart of accounts

Prepare the month-end close file and supporting schedules for review



Payroll and Statutory Support



Own the payroll change cycle: enter approved new hires, approved terminations, and approved rate or salary changes into the payroll system

Verify that every approved change has been entered before the cutoff, and prepare the payroll change summary for review

Prepare the monthly payroll run, ensuring deductions, classifications, and filings are correct and on time. (Approval of the underlying changes, review of the change report, and final approval and submission of payroll all sit with the Managing Director.)

Maintain a clean distinction between payroll and contractor payment per engagement classification

Prepare annual contractor tax forms

Assemble the underlying numbers for state tax filings, workers' compensation premium audits, and annual insurance renewals



You prepare and support these. You do not own the filing decision or the external relationships.



Systems, Documentation and Automation



Run each finance process manually and correctly before proposing to change it

Write and update the procedure for every recurring task you own, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong

Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive, rules-based work, and store them in a form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform

Quality check automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct

Support the migration of finance data and workflows into the new operating platform, and own the approval steps it routes to a person

Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it

Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed



What You Bring



Six or more years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in a professional or technical services environment

Demonstrable QuickBooks Online experience: coding, reconciling, invoicing, and closing. Not familiarity — this has been your actual job.

Accuracy under volume, and the discipline to resolve a reconciling item rather than carry it

The judgment to reason about where a transaction belongs, and the honesty to say "I am not sure about this one" instead of guessing

Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to describe a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you verify the output.

Experience building or maintaining a workflow or automation in any tool, or clear evidence you look for the systemic fix rather than repeating the workaround

Strong written English

Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly



Strong advantages



CPA, or an equivalent national professional accountancy qualification

A degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

Experience maintaining books for more than one entity under common ownership

Experience with time tracking systems, relational database tools, expense and card management platforms, payroll providers, or workflow automation platforms

Experience through a finance system migration or accounting software implementation

Exposure to a regulated, audited, or ISO-certified environment

Experience supporting a US-based firm



How Success Is Measured



100% of completed engagements invoiced within the defined period

Debtor days within agreed target

100% of reconciliations completed on cycle, with no unresolved items carried forward

Month-end close file delivered within the agreed timetable

Zero payments released against unmatched or unverified documentation

Coding accuracy verified on review sample

A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left

Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow

Both entities closed cleanly and separately, with no cross-coding between them

Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly



How to Apply

Complete our application form here: 



It takes about ten minutes. To confirm you have read this posting in full, include the code BK-2026-READ where the application asks for it. We will respond to every applicant who completes the form.

title: Executive Assistant / OBM / Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory.



Right now a large volume of daily operational work sits on the founder's desk. Around 45 recurring administrative and IT tasks are documented, along with a long tail of requests that have never been written down at all. This role takes them over.



The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets,
 threads, and automations with custom software, with the first phase going live shortly. A lot of what you learn manually in your first months will be automated in your later ones. They need someone who understands why the current process works the way it does, so that when the new system takes over, someone there can still tell when it is producing the wrong answer.



Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no department to hand something to. If you spot a problem, you either own it or you flag it, and both are fine. Priorities move, several things run at once, and you will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between. As the company grows this role will change shape more than once. That suits some people and frustrates others, and it is worth knowing which one you are before you apply.



This is not a role where you wait to be told the same thing twice. You learn a process, run it correctly, write down what the instructions were missing, and then help make it faster.



What You'll Own



Workflow, Automation and Documentation (about 40%)



Learn each recurring process by running it manually and correctly before proposing to change it

Write and update standard operating procedures as you go, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong

Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive work, stored in portable form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform

Maintain existing automations across the connected tools: diagnose failures, find where a handoff broke, fix or escalate

Review automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct. An automation that quietly produces the wrong result is worse than a manual step, and catching that is part of this role.

Support the rollout of the new operating platform: test workflows, migrate and clean data, own the approval steps the system routes to a person, and report what is not working

Complete the outstanding data migration work, including backfilling historical engagement records that were never entered into the system of record

Maintain the SOP library and the automation library side by side, with consistent naming and version control

Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it

Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed. This is the primary measure of the role.



Operations Execution (about 40%)



Run the new-engagement launch sequence, two to three times a week, across four connected systems

Act as the operational glue: keep projects moving, chase what is stuck, and handle the daily requests that keep the firm running

Take on work delegated directly by the Managing Director, ranging from research and follow-up to standing responsibilities that move off her desk permanently as you demonstrate you can hold them

Quality check the output of the processes you run and the automations you build: verify results against the source, catch errors before they reach a client or a report, and correct the process rather than only the instance

Support the quality review process: upload and format audit reports, run and check an AI-assisted first-pass review, track what is waiting on whom, and keep reports from stalling between reviewer and auditor. (You will not perform the review or make audit judgments — you keep the queue moving.)

Handle certificate of insurance requests, vendor onboarding packets, and W-9 issuance

Maintain the vendor and subcontractor register and the supporting documentation set

Calendar and inbox support for leadership, including meeting notes, action item tracking, and follow-through to completion



Systems Administration and Records (about 20%)



Provision accounts and access for new team members across Google Workspace and eight other platforms, and support onboarding and offboarding

Maintain the Google Drive structure, permissions, naming conventions, and file cleanup

Maintain the software subscription register: what renews when, what nobody uses, what should be cancelled

Maintain
 marketing list hygiene: before every send, confirm no unsubscribed contacts remain on the active mailing list

Support hiring logistics, credential tracking, and HR administration



Bookkeeping and finance are a separate role. You will work alongside the bookkeeper, and there are handoff points between you, but you do not own the finance cycle.



What You Bring



Six or more years in an operations, executive assistant, business management, or process coordination role supporting leadership directly

Experience in a company where processes were not fully documented, and you were part of fixing that

Demonstrated experience building or maintaining workflows and automations, in any tool

Excellent written English. You will draft internal and occasional external communications.

Proven ability to follow a written procedure exactly, and to notice and report when the procedure is wrong

Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to tell us about a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you check that its output is correct.

Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly

Comfort with systems administration: user provisioning, permissions, and file structure

Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet space for video calls

Ability to commit to heavy US Central overlap during onboarding, and four to six hours daily thereafter



Strong advantages



Experience designing or building a CRM, database, or internal system, not only using one

Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms, database automations, or building custom AI skills and agents

Experience building or maintaining a knowledge base, wiki, SOP library, or internal training system

Experience in an ISO-certified environment: document control, internal audits, management systems, quality or environmental standards

Exposure to electronics manufacturing, recycling, IT asset disposition, or data destruction compliance

Experience with relational database tools, time tracking systems, project management platforms, or Google Workspace administration

Experience being part of a software implementation or system migration



Who This Is Not For



This is not a data entry role and not a general virtual assistant role. If you need a stable queue of identical tasks, a defined lane, or a manager who assigns your day, this will frustrate you. If your plan is to run everything through an AI tool and send the first thing it produces, you will not pass our assessment. We care as much about how you check work as how you produce it.



How Success Is Measured



A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left

Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow

Errors found by quality checks before they reach a client, a report, or leadership

Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly

Engagement launches completed within the defined window, with no missed setup steps

Audit reports moved through the review queue without stalling

Access provisioning and deprovisioning completed within the defined period, with no orphaned accounts

The task and question log maintained continuously and reviewed on cycle

Zero sends to a mailing list containing unsubscribed contacts



How to Apply

Complete our application form here:

title: Proofreader & KDP Formatting Specialist
description:
# Job Posting: Proofreader & KDP Formatting Specialist



**Project:** Beauty Reimagined Spiritual Productivity Planner

**Type:** Freelance / Contract (Project-Based)

**Format:** Remote



---



## About the Project



Beauty Reimagined (BR) is a faith-lifestyle brand publishing a 12-month, faith-based spiritual productivity planner for women of faith. The manuscript is a large, image-rich Word document (600+ pages) built with a consistent monthly structure — devotionals, declarations, scripture reflections, goal-setting pages, weekly schedules, daily intention grids, and reflection sections — wrapped in a custom deep-plum-and-gold design.



We're looking for a detail-oriented freelancer to take the manuscript through its final two steps before it goes live on Amazon: a full proofread, and conversion into a fully KDP-compliant, print-ready file.



---



## Scope of Work



**1. Proofreading**

- Read through the full manuscript for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and typographical errors

- Check consistency of scripture references, quotation formatting, and recurring phrases across all 12 months

- Flag any repeated or missing content (e.g., duplicated pages, inconsistent section structure between months)

- Verify dates, headers, and labels are accurate and consistent throughout

- Deliver a marked-up list of corrections (tracked changes or a separate issues log — your preference)



**2. KDP Formatting & Conversion**

- Convert the corrected manuscript into a print-ready file that meets Amazon KDP's current paperback specifications, including:

  - Correct trim size, margins, and gutter for an 8.5" x 11" trim at the book's final page count

  - Proper bleed setup if any full-bleed images are present (uniform page size across the entire interior file — no mixed bleed/non-bleed pages)

  - Embedded fonts, flattened transparency, no crop marks/metadata/placeholder text

  - Correct, sequential pagination

  - Export to a KDP-compliant PDF

- Run the file through KDP's online previewer (or equivalent QA) and resolve any flagged issues before final delivery

- Confirm final page count is even and within KDP's allowed range for the trim size



---



## Deliverables



- Proofread manuscript with all corrections applied (Word .docx)

- Final print-ready, KDP-compliant interior PDF

- A short summary of any formatting decisions made or issues encountered



---



## Requirements



**Core Skills**

- Proven experience proofreading long-form manuscripts (books, planners, workbooks, or similar)

- Hands-on experience formatting interiors for Amazon KDP specifically (not just general PDF/Word design)

- Comfortable working with Microsoft Word at scale (300+ page documents, styles, section breaks, mirrored margins)

- Strong attention to detail and consistency across repetitive, templated content



**Technical / Software**

- Adobe Acrobat (or equivalent) for final PDF quality checks — embedded fonts, flattened transparency, no stray metadata before upload

- Working knowledge of font embedding — this manuscript uses custom fonts (Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond), and KDP will reject a file if fonts aren't properly embedded

- Comfortable working with large, image-heavy Word files (600+ pages, dozens of embedded images) — this is a different scale than a typical manuscript

- Basic image/DPI literacy — able to identify a low-resolution image before it becomes a print problem



**Process & Reliability**

- Version control discipline — this manuscript has gone through 25+ revisions, so tracking changes without silently overwriting prior fixes is essential

- Ability to follow an established style guide and preserve locked-in phrasing choices, rather than "correcting" them to personal preference

- Willingness to sign a simple confidentiality agreement, as this is unpublished original content



**Content-Specific**

- Care and precision verifying quoted scripture references match the cited translation exactly

- Sensitivity to devotional/spiritual tone — this is not a project for aggressive line-editing or rewriting of voice



**Practical**

- A realistic turnaround estimate provided upfront, given the file size and scope

- Willingness to complete one month as a paid test/sample before taking on the full 12-month project



## Nice to Have



- Experience with tools like Vellum, Atticus, InDesign, or Affinity Publisher for print layout

- Portfolio or samples of previously formatted KDP paperbacks

- Familiarity with faith-based or lifestyle publishing content



---



## How to Apply



Please include:

1. A brief note on your relevant proofreading and KDP formatting experience

2. Links or samples of at least one KDP paperback you've formatted (interior file or published listing)

3. Your estimated turnaround time and rate for a project of this scope



---



*Beauty Reimagined / Beauty Powerhouse Chicago — faith-lifestyle brand and boutique salon based on Chicago's South Side.*

title: Senior AutoCAD Drafter & Project Coordinator – Architectural Metalwork
description:
We are an Australian metalwork company seeking an experienced Senior AutoCAD Drafter and Project Coordinator to join our team remotely on a full-time basis.



The primary responsibility of this role is producing accurate and practical AutoCAD 2D shop drawings for architectural and structural metalwork. The successful applicant must also be capable of independently coordinating projects and communicating professionally with clients, architects, engineers, builders and other consultants.



Our typical scope includes:



* Balustrades and handrails

* Privacy and decorative screens

* Louvres and sunshades

* Gates and fences

* Awnings and pergolas

* Façade elements and architectural metalwork

* General structural steel and aluminium components



Key responsibilities:



* Prepare general arrangement, fabrication and installation drawings using AutoCAD 2D

* Interpret architectural, structural and consultant drawings

* Develop practical connection, fixing, fabrication and installation details

* Identify clashes, discrepancies, constructability issues and missing information

* Prepare and manage RFIs, drawing registers, material schedules and transmittals

* Revise drawings promptly based on client and consultant comments

* Coordinate shop-drawing submissions, reviews and approvals

* Communicate professionally with clients, architects, engineers and builders

* Attend and actively participate in online design and coordination meetings

* Prepare meeting minutes and follow up outstanding actions

* Resolve design and coordination matters independently wherever possible

* Manage assigned projects from initial documentation through to shop-drawing approval

* Maintain organised project records and correspondence

* Assist with general project administration

* Occasionally assist with quantity take-offs and estimating when drafting workloads are lighter



The successful applicant must not simply copy information from architectural or structural drawings. You must be able to review the entire design, identify potential problems and produce coordinated drawings that can be practically manufactured and installed.



Mandatory qualifications and experience:



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture or another relevant discipline

* Strong professional experience using AutoCAD 2D

* Previous drafting experience in architectural metalwork, façades, balustrades, louvres, screens, aluminium or structural steel

* Good understanding of fabrication, connections and installation requirements

* Ability to work with Bluebeam Revu

* Professional written and spoken English

* Confidence communicating directly with clients, architects, engineers and builders

* Ability to attend and actively participate in online coordination meetings

* Ability to manage assigned projects and resolve issues with minimal supervision

* Strong organisational and project administration skills

* Exceptional attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

* Ability to produce drawings quickly without compromising quality

* Excellent responsiveness during agreed working hours

* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Availability to work hours that provide reasonable overlap with Sydney business hours



Software requirements:



The successful applicant must have their own computer and access to a recent, properly licensed version of AutoCAD. AutoCAD software and licensing will not be provided by the company.



Applicants must also be able to use Bluebeam Revu confidently. A Bluebeam licence may be provided if required.



Experience with Revit, SketchUp and estimating will be considered an advantage but is not essential.



This is a long-term, full-time remote position. The right person will be trusted to manage assigned projects independently and will have opportunities to take on greater project coordination and estimating responsibilities based on their performance and capability.



To apply, please provide:



1. Your CV

2. Details of your university degree

3. Examples of relevant shop drawings or a portfolio

4. Details of your metalwork or façade drafting experience

5. Examples of projects you have coordinated directly with clients and consultants

6. Your level of AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Revit and SketchUp experience

7. Your project administration and estimating experience

8. Confirmation that you have access to a recent licensed version of AutoCAD

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. Your availability to commence



Shortlisted applicants will be given a drafting and coordination assessment to demonstrate their technical understanding, speed, accuracy, drawing quality, attention to detail and communication skills.

title: Social Media Content & Marketing Assistant — AI Reels & Carousels
description:
Long-term remote opportunity | Flexible production schedule | Training & ongoing mentorship included



We operate two parenting content brands: an Islamic parenting brand, and a general non-religious parenting brand.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented assistant who can research engaging content ideas, follow our creative systems, and produce consistent videos and carousels. Training, ongoing mentor support throughout the job, and required paid tool access will be provided.



Content targets



After training, our target is eight finished posts per  day across both brands:



* 1st brand: two short-form Reels and two carousels.

* 2nd brand: two short-form Reels and two carousels.



That totals 28 Reels and 28 complete carousel posts per week. A carousel means the full multi-slide post, not an individual image.



Where appropriate, content can begin from shared parenting concepts, then be adapted separately for each brand’s audience, wording, visuals, and message.



What we provide



* Training in our content research and production workflow.

* Ongoing guidance and support from a mentor throughout the job, not just during onboarding, including feedback, answers to workflow questions, and help improving your content and production skills.

* Script frameworks, storyboard and prompt examples, visual references, and templates.

* Clear brand guidelines and examples of the expected quality.

* Required paid AI and editing tool access.

* Feedback and approval before publishing.



You will help research and develop content using these resources; this is not a role where every finished script and creative decision is supplied.



Your responsibilities



* Research relevant parenting topics and strong content angles using our process.

* Develop original hooks, scripts, and carousel copy with AI assistance and our frameworks.

* Submit content ideas and drafts for approval before full production.

* Generate consistent AI images and animate scenes using our workflow.

* Edit Reels with voiceover, captions, approved soundtracks, and effective pacing.

* Produce complete carousels using our established styles and templates.

* Check spelling, text overflow, visual consistency, and brand accuracy.

* Flag factual or religious claims for verification rather than inventing references.

* Organize project files and schedule approved content.



The role does not include customer service, answering DMs, community management, or paid advertising.



Schedule and workload



You may batch the full week’s content into five days or fewer, or spread production across the week, provided approved posts are ready before their publishing deadlines.



The paid trial will include research, production, quality checks, and revisions so we can agree on a realistic workload and schedule before committing to the ongoing arrangement. If the target is not sustainable, we will review the process and scope rather than assume unlimited extra hours.



Requirements



* Practical CapCut skills and experience designing multi-slide carousels.

* Familiarity with Canva and AI image or video tools.

* Good written English and strong attention to detail.

* Ability to research ideas without copying other creators’ work.

* Reliable computer, internet, and communication.

* Ability to keep Islamic and non-religious brand content distinct.

* Willingness to follow detailed instructions and apply feedback consistently.



Compensation and training



* $400 USD per month, paid $200 twice monthly.

* A short paid production test, with scope and payment agreed beforehand.

* Fully paid training during a 30-day probation period if hired.

* Continued training and mentor support after probation, included as part of the role at no cost to you.

* Potential future pay reviews or bonuses based on quality, reliability, and business affordability. No increase or bonus is guaranteed.



How to apply



Begin your application with PARENTING and include:



1. Your country, time zone, and current work commitments.

2. Your weekly availability and preferred production schedule.

3. Three relevant examples of videos or carousel designs.

4. The editing and AI tools you know.

5. One parenting topic you would adapt for both brands, briefly explaining how the versions would differ.

6. Your realistic time estimate for the stated workload, including research and revisions.

7. Whether you are seeking an ongoing role for at least six months.



Please be honest about your capacity. Clear communication and sustainable consistency matter more than promising unrealistic speed.



Applications that do not begin with PARENTING will not be reviewed.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design

III. Final Interview

title: Creator Sourcing & Outreach VA
description:
Real Mad Honey is a premium DTC brand selling wild Himalayan mad honey, sourced by hand at 3,500+ 

meters and third-party tested for purity. We've served 50,000+ customers and we're growing fast.



We're hiring a VA who will report directly to the Creator Partnerships Manager — owning creator sourcing, 

outreach, and keeping our whole partnerships operation organized and easy to navigate. This is a hands-on 

assisting role, not just task execution: you'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Finding Creators

• Look online for creators who make content we could work with.

• Check if each one is really a good fit for our brand — not just how many followers they have.

• Write down why each one is a good pick, so a decision can be made fast.

• Be the first point of contact, and inform the manager on rates for negotiation.



Organizing Our Files & Content

• Keep our files and folders neat, so anyone on the team can find what they need in seconds.

• When videos or photos come in from a creator, save, label, and keep track of them the right way — so 

nothing gets lost, and no one has to dig through a mess to find a clip later.

• Keep a simple, up-to-date list of every deal: who it's with, what stage it's at, when it's due, and whether 

it's paid.

• Make sure product gets shipped and creators get their tracking info.



Helping the Manager

• Tell the manager right away if a creator is doing great work — they might be worth a bigger deal.

• Tell the manager right away if something's going wrong. Don't wait and hope it fixes itself.

• Help build our creator community across our programs — seeding, ambassadors, and more.

• Help with other small tasks as they come up. This role grows as you do.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

• You know the kind of creators and personas that fit our brand.

• You've sourced your first few creators.

• You understand our budget and know how to lock in a deal — rate, contract, all of it.

• You know how our database works and how we keep it clean and organized.

• You understand the different creator programs we run, the tools we use to source, and how our whole 

system fits together.



First 60 Days

• You're finding and vetting creators without needing much guidance.

• Our files and content are organized well enough that someone else could jump in and understand 

everything.

• You're catching problems early and flagging them before they get bigger.

• You're starting to spot creators who could grow into bigger roles — ambassadors, repeat collaborators — 

and flagging them to the manager.



First 120 Days

• You're running the sourcing and organizing side of this role on your own.

• The manager trusts your picks and your organization without double-checking.

• You're already suggesting ways to make the process better.

• You're helping the manager grow our creator community across all our programs — seeding, 

ambassadors, Trybe, and beyond.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience with UGC sourcing or creator management, ideally in a DTC or e-commerce 

context.

• Comfortable finding and vetting talent across sourcing platforms.

• Experience supporting paid ads teams and understanding how UGC feeds into performance creative.

• Strong eye for creator quality — you can tell who fits the brand and who'll actually perform, before you 

ever send an outreach message.

• Excellent written English for outreach, negotiations, and creator briefs.

• Organized across multiple timelines, multiple creators, and multiple campaigns simultaneously.

• Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers and general workspace tools.



MUST HAVES

• Straight to the point communicator. No long, confusing instructions needed either direction.

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told.

• Integrity. We're remote and run on trust.

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing your own time without needing constant check-ins.

• This must be your only job. Full commitment, full presence.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Someone organized enough that a manager can hand off a messy pile of creator info and trust it comes back 

usable — clear, honest, and dependable.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us your resume (CV) and a short intro video telling us about yourself and your motivation — we want to 

see your energy and how you communicate, not just read about it.

If you're shortlisted, we'll send you the test assignment as the next step.



Start your application with the words “Honey Hive” so we know you actually read this whole posting.

We read everything. 



Real applications only — copy-paste responses will be ignored.

title: Client Ops Associate
description:
Client Ops Associate (Path to Key Account Manager)

Full Time | Remote | Reports to Head of Ops/Delivery



About the company

CivSav is a digital marketing agency built specifically for agriculture and heavy machinery companies across the USA. We run SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, and
/lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo) for a growing roster of ag clients. We're a lean, fast-moving team — not a big-agency bureaucracy — and we're scaling from a strong client base toward 100+ accounts without losing the quality that got us here.



About the role

We're hiring a Client Ops Associate to be the operational backbone of our client relationships. This is not a call-center support role and it's not a senior strategist role — it's the seat where someone proves they can be trusted with a client relationship, and grows from there.



You'll start by making sure nothing falls through the cracks: onboarding new clients, keeping tabs on what's been delivered versus what's been promised, and handling the day-to-day questions clients have. If you're good at this — organized, calm under pressure, and someone clients trust — this role is the direct path to owning a full book of clients as a Key Account Manager.



We are deliberately hiring this as an assistant-level role with a real growth path, not a dead-end support job. The person we hire in twelve months should look nothing like the person we hire today.



What success looks like

- New clients are onboarded smoothly: accounts and access collected without chasing, kickoff calls run on time, nothing missed.

- Clients get fast, clear answers to routine questions, and you know exactly when something needs to go to a specialist or to leadership instead of you handling it yourself.

- Nothing executed for a client goes untracked. If someone asks "where are we on X client," you have the answer in under a minute.

- You build a track record of good judgment — knowing what you can decide on your own and what needs a second opinion — that earns you more client ownership over time.



Key responsibilities



Customer support

- First point of contact for routine client questions and requests.

- Follow a clear escalation path: technical issues to the relevant specialist, anything involving expectations, money, or a frustrated client to your manager.

- Keep client communication professional, timely, and honest — we do not overpromise to make a moment easier.



Onboarding

- Run new clients through our onboarding process: collecting domain, ad account,Klaviyo, and analytics access.Onboarding clients on meta and GHL.

- Schedule and run kickoff calls using our onboarding playbook.

- Make sure every new client is fully set up and hands off cleanly to the delivery team.



Project management assistance

- Track what's been executed for each client across SEO, ads,
, and web — using our shared tracking system.

- Flag work that's stalled or at risk before it becomes a client complaint.

- Keep a clear, current record any manager can check without needing to ask you directly.



Growth path

- Months 0–3: support, onboarding, and tracking, fully trained on our systems, all client-facing work reviewed before it goes out.

- Months 3–6: independently own a small group of standard-tier clients — ongoing check-ins, reporting, routine decisions — with regular check-ins with your manager.

- Months 6–12+: full ownership of an assigned client roster as a Key Account Manager, with review shifting to spot-checks and true escalations only.



Progression is based on demonstrated judgment and reliability, not just time served.



About you — required

- Excellent written and verbal English communication.

- Highly organized — you naturally track details without being told twice.

- Comfortable talking to clients directly, including when a conversation is a little uncomfortable.

- Genuinely ambitious about growing into a client-ownership role, not just looking for a support job.

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace for client calls, and availability during US business hours.



About you — preferred

- Prior experience in an agency, customer success, or account coordination role.

- Familiarity with basic digital marketing concepts (you don't need to run SEO or ads, but you should be able to follow a conversation about them).

- Familiarity with GHL, Meta Business Suite

- Experience with a task-tracking tool (ClickUp, Jira, spreadsheets, or similar).







How to apply

We read every application carefully, and we pay close attention to how instructions are followed — it tells us a lot before we ever get on a call.



Subject line: "Hi, I'm YOUR NAME from CITY/COUNTRY and I'm applying for the Client Ops Associate role."



In the body of your
, include:

1. A two-sentence opening: your name, where you're from, and that you're applying.

2. Three sentences on the most relevant experience you have for this specific role.

3. Three sentences on a time you had to stay organized while juggling multiple people's expectations at once — what happened, and how you kept it from falling apart.

4. Three sentences on where you want to be in two years, and why this role is a step toward that.

5. A closing line with your name,
, and phone number.



Attach your current resume or CV.



Candidates who follow these instructions completely move to the next stage, which includes a short scenario exercise designed to show us how you think under a bit of pressure — not to trick you, but to make sure we're both confident before we ever put you in a room with a client.

description:

Forms and surveys

Sites and funnels

Basic account and user settings

Workflow history and basic troubleshooting

WHAT WE NEED

Speaks and writes clear, natural, professional English

, chat, and voice calls

Report completed work, open conversations, problems, and follow-up needs



SALES AND COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



We are not looking for someone who only copies and pastes scripts word for word.



Scripts, procedures, and approved answers will be provided, but you must understand the purpose of the conversation and communicate like a real person.



You must be able to:



Establish rapport naturally

Understand the prospect’s business and current challenges

Ask relevant questions

Determine whether the prospect is a good fit

Communicate value without making exaggerated promises

Handle common objections professionally

Move qualified prospects toward a scheduled call or approved purchase process

Avoid inventing pricing, guarantees, results, or company policies



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Demonstrated hands-on GoHighLevel experience

Excellent spoken English

Excellent written English

Previous experience in appointment setting, sales, customer support, lead generation, or client operations

Experience communicating directly with leads or customers

Strong organizational and follow-up skills

Reliable computer suitable for voice calls and browser-based work

Stable primary internet connection

Quality headset and quiet professional workspace

Reliable attendance and consistent communication



STRONGLY PREFERRED

[INSERT APPLICATION FORM LINK]

title: Social Media Content Manager
description:
Facebook • Instagram • LinkedIn | Two Personal Brands | Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for an exceptional Social Media Content Manager to help manage the personal brands of two U.S.-based insurance and financial-services professionals: a mother and daughter who work together in business.



This is not a generic VA posting job.



We will provide you with the raw ingredients:



Photos

Videos

Personal stories

Business activities

Travel

Speaking engagements

Community involvement

Podcast content

Industry information

Ideas and thoughts

Context about what is happening in our lives and businesses



THE TWO PERSONAL BRANDS



You will be creating content for Kelly and Hailey, a mother-daughter team in the U.S. insurance and financial-services industry.



They work together but have different voices, personalities and audiences.



Your job is to learn both.



Kelly



Kelly is an experienced business owner, insurance professional, advocate, public speaker and community leader.



Her content includes:



Business and entrepreneurship

Insurance and financial education

Advocacy and public policy

Leadership

Community

Travel

Personal reflections

Family

Lifestyle

Speaking

Behind-the-scenes life

Podcast content

Her voice is thoughtful, confident, conversational and occasionally provocative.



Hailey



Hailey represents a different generation and perspective.



Her content should have its own voice and should NEVER simply be a rewritten version of Kelly's content.



Part of your job will be learning what makes each woman sound distinctly like herself.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Each day, you will receive or have access to photos, videos, ideas and context from Kelly and Hailey.



You will transform those materials into platform-appropriate content for:




Instagram

LinkedIn



Our initial content framework provides for up to:



3 content opportunities per platform, per person, per day.



That means you must be capable of managing a high-volume content pipeline across six social profiles.



However:

We value quality over filling a quota.



Not every content opportunity must become a feed post.



Depending on the content and platform, you should recommend whether something belongs as:



Feed post

Story

Reel

Carousel

Professional insight

Personal post

Short-form thought

Engagement post

Or should NOT be posted at all



We are looking for judgment, not just output.



PLATFORM DIFFERENTIATION IS REQUIRED



If Kelly gives you one photograph and tells you:



"I had coffee this morning with an insurance agent who reminded me how important mentorship is in our industry."



We do NOT want you to write one caption and copy it three times.



You should understand how to turn that ONE moment into:



LinkedIn



A professional thought about mentorship, leadership or developing the next generation of insurance professionals.






A warmer personal story about the conversation and relationship.



Instagram



A shorter, visually driven caption with an engaging hook.



Same person. Same photograph. Same underlying story. Three different pieces of content.



That ability is central to this job.



CONTENT SCHEDULE



Content will generally be distributed across three U.S. audience windows:



Morning: approximately 6:30–7:30 AM Pacific Time



Afternoon: approximately 11:00 AM–12:30 PM Pacific Time



Evening: approximately 4:30–6:00 PM Pacific Time



You do NOT need to be awake at those hours.



We expect you to use scheduling tools once direct publishing privileges have been granted.



Over time, you will also be expected to review analytics and recommend better posting times based on OUR actual audience behavior.



FIRST 30 DAYS



You will NOT initially receive direct access to our social media accounts.



During the training period:



We provide content → You create posts → We review → We approve or revise.



We will teach you our voices through feedback.



Your responsibility is to learn from that feedback so the number of revisions steadily decreases.



We are specifically looking for someone who can eventually reach the point where we read a post and say:



"Yes. That's exactly how I would have said it."



Once that trust has been established, we will provide appropriate access so you can schedule and publish approved content directly.



Eventually, the right person will independently manage much of the daily publishing calendar.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



At the beginning:



We correct you.



Then:



We occasionally correct you.



Eventually:



You know what we're going to say before we say it.



Our ideal Social Media Content Manager learns:



What Kelly will post

What Kelly will NOT post

What Hailey will post

What Hailey will NOT post

Their vocabulary

Their humor

Their opinions

Their professional boundaries

Their audiences

Their preferred content styles



We want someone interested in becoming part of our long-term media team.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



Create platform-specific social media copy

Organize provided photos and videos

Maintain a weekly content calendar

Recommend content formats

Create simple Canva graphics when appropriate

Schedule approved content

Maintain consistent personal-brand voices

Repurpose podcast and business content

Track published content

Monitor basic performance analytics

Identify which topics and formats perform best

Recommend improvements monthly

Maintain organized content archives

Avoid repetitive posts

Fact-check professional claims before submitting content

Flag anything you are unsure about rather than guessing



IMPORTANT: AI USE



You may use AI tools to assist your work.



However:



We do not want AI-generated personalities.



If every caption sounds polished, generic, inspirational and interchangeable, this will not work.



AI can help you work faster.



It cannot replace learning Kelly and Hailey's voices.



We will recognize generic AI copy immediately.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



Excellent written American English

Strong understanding of

Strong understanding of Instagram

Strong understanding of LinkedIn

Experience managing personal brands

Excellent attention to detail

Strong organizational skills

Canva proficiency

Experience with social scheduling tools

Ability to work independently

Reliable internet

Ability to meet weekly deadlines

Excellent judgment and discretion



Experience with insurance, financial services, professional services or executive personal brands is helpful but not required.



Writing ability and judgment matter more.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation: $250 USD per week



This is an independent contractor position.

title: Business Development Representatives
description:
# Business Development Representative (BDR)



**Location:** Philippines – Remote

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Schedule:** North American/Canadian business hours

**Industry:** Telecommunications / Business Solutions



## About the Role



We are looking for an energetic and results-driven **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to join our growing telecommunications sales team.



The BDR will be responsible for identifying potential business customers, contacting decision-makers, qualifying opportunities, and booking qualified appointments for our Canadian-based Account Executives.



This is a **prospecting and appointment-setting position**. You do not need to close the final sale. Your primary responsibility is to create qualified sales opportunities for the sales team.



## Key Responsibilities



### Lead Generation & Prospecting



* Research and identify potential business customers in Canada.

* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified prospects.

* Use online research, business directories, LinkedIn, CRM systems, and provided lead lists to identify decision-makers.

* Identify businesses that may benefit from telecommunications and business connectivity solutions.



### Outbound Calling



* Make high-volume outbound calls to Canadian businesses.

* Speak with business owners, managers, and decision-makers.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions in a professional and engaging manner.

* Ask discovery questions to understand the customer's current provider, needs, and potential opportunities.

* Handle common objections and move qualified prospects to the next step.



### Appointment Setting



* Schedule qualified appointments for Canadian Account Executives.

* Ensure appointments meet our qualification criteria.

* Provide accurate notes and customer information before handing the opportunity to the Account Executive.

* Follow up with prospects who are not immediately ready to speak with a sales representative.



### CRM & Reporting



* Accurately document calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointments in the CRM.

* Maintain accurate prospect and contact information.

* Track daily activity and results.

* Provide daily/weekly reports on calls, contacts, qualified leads, and appointments.

* Meet established activity and performance targets.



## BDR Performance Targets



Initial targets will include:



* **100+ outbound calls per day**

* Consistent prospect follow-up

* **Qualified appointments booked**

* Accurate CRM documentation

* High appointment show rate

* Pipeline development

* Contribution to closed sales/revenue



Performance will be measured primarily by **quality of opportunities generated**, not simply the number of calls made.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has **1–3+ years of B2B outbound sales, BDR, SDR, appointment-setting, or telemarketing experience**

* Is comfortable making cold calls

* Has excellent spoken English

* Can communicate confidently with Canadian and North American customers

* Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

* Can handle rejection and objections professionally

* Is highly motivated by sales targets and performance bonuses

* Has strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Is comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Has experience using CRM systems

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace



### Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is an advantage:



* Telecommunications

* Wireless/mobile services

* Internet/ISP

* B2B technology sales

* SaaS

* Business services

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* Canadian or US outbound sales



## Compensation



**Base Salary:** ₱30,000–₱45,000/month depending on experience



**Performance Bonuses:** Additional compensation based on qualified appointments, sales opportunities, and overall team performance.



Top performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and advancement.



## Career Growth



This position is designed to provide a career path within our growing sales organization.



High-performing BDRs may progress to:



**BDR → Senior BDR → BDR Team Leader → Sales Manager**



## What We Offer



* Competitive Philippine salary

* Performance-based bonuses

* Remote work

* Sales training and coaching

* CRM and sales tools provided

* Opportunity to work with a Canadian telecommunications sales organization

* Career advancement opportunities

* Performance recognition and incentives



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Resume/CV

2. Summary of your B2B sales or BDR experience

3. Previous experience with Canadian or US customers, if applicable

4. Your expected monthly salary

5. Internet and computer specifications

6. Short audio/video introduction explaining why you would be a good fit for this position



**Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a telephone/role-play sales assessment before receiving an offer.**

title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel
description:
# YouTube Documentary Video Editor – Long-Form Faceless Channel



We are looking for a talented **YouTube Documentary Video Editor** to join a growing faceless YouTube channel.



Our videos are story-driven documentaries focused on **Canada, cities, regional identity, history, culture, politics, economics, rivalries, and major events**.



Typical videos will be approximately **20–40 minutes long**.



This is not a simple “put stock footage over a voiceover” editing job.



We are looking for an editor who understands **storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, visual variety, and documentary-style editing**.



## WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE



For each video, you will generally receive:



* Final voiceover

* Completed script

* Organized visual assets

* Archival photographs and footage

* B-roll

* Maps, charts, screenshots and other supporting materials

* Source information where relevant

* Editing instructions for important sequences



You will **not normally be expected to research the entire video from scratch**.



However, a strong editor should be capable of finding additional appropriate visuals when something is missing or when a better visual would significantly improve the scene.



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will turn the supplied materials into a polished, engaging YouTube documentary.



This includes:



* Editing the complete video around the voiceover

* Selecting the strongest available visuals for each narration beat

* Creating strong visual pacing

* Using archival photographs and footage effectively

* Adding maps, headlines, screenshots, documents and graphics where appropriate

* Creating simple motion graphics and animations

* Adding tasteful zooms, pans and movement to still photographs

* Using text and on-screen information when it strengthens the story

* Adding appropriate music and sound design

* Mixing audio properly

* Creating smooth transitions between sections

* Maintaining visual continuity and a consistent documentary style

* Finding supplementary visuals when necessary

* Delivering a finished video ready for YouTube



## THE EDITING STYLE



The editing should feel like a **modern YouTube documentary**, not a corporate presentation and not an over-edited TikTok video.



We value:



**Storytelling over effects.**



Every visual should help explain the story, establish a location or period, provide evidence, create emotion, or maintain viewer attention.



We do NOT want random stock footage inserted simply because something needs to appear on screen.



We also do not want excessive transitions, constant sound effects, unnecessary animation, or distracting editing tricks.



Good judgment matters.



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have experience editing long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, video essays, history content, geography content, or similar storytelling formats.



You should understand:



* YouTube audience retention

* Documentary pacing

* Visual storytelling

* B-roll selection

* Archival imagery

* Music and sound design

* Motion graphics

* Maps and basic data visualization

* How to keep a 20–40 minute video visually interesting without making it exhausting



You should also be comfortable receiving detailed feedback and making revisions.



## SOFTWARE



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing platform is acceptable.



After Effects or similar motion-graphics capability is an advantage.



## VERY IMPORTANT: COPYRIGHT



You must understand basic copyright and licensing requirements.



Do not download random images or footage from Google, YouTube, TikTok,
 or other websites and insert them into our videos without authorization.



Any additional assets you source must have appropriate licensing or usage rights, and the source must be documented.



## PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **small paid editing test of approximately 2–3 minutes**.



The same voiceover, script and asset package will be provided to shortlisted candidates so that editing quality can be compared fairly.



The test will evaluate:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Visual selection

* Music

* Sound design

* Graphics

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions

* Overall professional quality



## LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



This is intended to become an ongoing position.



We are building a library of documentary videos and expect to publish consistently.



If your work is excellent, there will be regular projects available.



We value editors who become familiar with the channel's visual language and improve with each video.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to **2–3 of your best long-form YouTube edits**.

3. At least one example involving documentary, history, geography, politics, economics, video essay, or similar storytelling content if available.

4. Tell us exactly what parts of those videos you personally edited.

5. Tell us what editing software you use.

6. Tell us approximately how long you would need to edit a polished 25–30 minute documentary when the voiceover, script and most visual assets are supplied.

7. Tell us your expected rate for a 25–30 minute finished video.

8. Confirm whether you are willing to complete a paid 2–3 minute editing test.



**To show that you read the entire job post, begin your application with the words:**



**“DOCUMENTARY EDITOR”**



Applications that do not include these words may not be reviewed.



Please do not send 15–20 portfolio links. Send only your strongest and most relevant work.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term working relationship**, not simply complete one video.
