title: Freelance Video Editor
description:
# Freelance Video Editor



**Type:** Freelance / Contract

**Compensation:** $500–$1,000 CAD per month

**Work Style:** Ongoing monthly editing support



## Role Purpose



Hot Tanks is looking for a reliable freelance Video Editor to turn approved raw footage into clear, professional, brand-consistent video content.



You will work with footage created by the Hot Tanks TEAM and prepare finished video assets for platforms such as Instagram,
, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and the Hot Tanks website.



This is primarily an editing role. Hot Tanks manages the content strategy, planning, approvals, scheduling, and publishing.



## What You Will Edit



Content may include:



* Educational and expert videos

* Client testimonials and review videos

* Short testimonial clips

* Installation and project footage

* Before-and-after videos

* Field B-roll

* Technician and TEAM introductions

* Service-quality and Signature Standard videos

* Client journey and “what to expect” videos

* Community content

* Behind-the-scenes and TEAM culture content



## Core Responsibilities



You will:



* Review raw footage provided by Hot Tanks.

* Select the strongest usable moments.

* Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated takes, and unusable footage.

* Create clean, natural edits with strong pacing.

* Keep speakers sounding natural and human.

* Add approved:



  * Logos

  * Lower thirds

  * Captions

  * Text overlays

  * Service labels

  * Transition cards

  * End frames

  * Calls to action

* Make basic adjustments to:



  * Audio

  * Exposure

  * Colour

  * Framing

* Add B-roll when it improves the story or explanation.

* Create vertical and horizontal versions when required.

* Create thumbnails when required.

* Export videos in the correct dimensions, resolution, and file format.

* Keep project files and finished exports organized.

* Complete reasonable revisions based on consolidated Hot Tanks feedback.



## Common Video Formats



Typical work may include:



### 9:16 Vertical Video



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts



### 16:9 Horizontal Video



* YouTube Main Videos

* Website videos

*
 native video



### Other Common Deliverables



* 15–30 second clips

* 30–60 second short-form videos

* 1–3 minute videos

* Thumbnails

* Occasional longer-form videos when required



Some source footage may require more than one finished format.



For example, the same source footage may be edited into both a vertical and horizontal version.



## Editing Style



Hot Tanks content should feel:



* Professional

* Clear

* Warm

* Trustworthy

* Clean

* Calm

* Natural

* Consistent



The goal is not to make every video flashy or heavily produced.



The finished video should help the viewer feel:



* “I understand what they are explaining.”

* “These people know what they are doing.”

* “They seem professional.”

* “I would feel comfortable having them in my home.”



## We Prefer



* Clean cuts

* Natural pacing

* Easy-to-read captions

* Simple graphics

* Consistent branding

* Strong opening moments

* Useful B-roll

* Minimal unnecessary effects

* Clear endings and calls to action



## Please Avoid



* Excessive animation

* Distracting transitions

* Aggressive zooming

* Overused sound effects

* Excessive text

* Meme-style editing unless specifically requested

* Trend-heavy editing that weakens the Hot Tanks brand

* Editing that changes the meaning of what someone said



## Brand Protection



The Video Editor must follow approved Hot Tanks brand assets, templates, and editing standards.



Do not independently:



* Change logos.

* Change brand colours.

* Rewrite approved company promises or standards.

* Create new company claims.

* Change the meaning of a client testimonial.

* Add pricing, guarantees, technical claims, or promotional language that was not provided or approved.

* Publish content directly unless specifically authorized.



Hot Tanks controls final approval and publishing.



## Monthly Work Structure



Work will normally be provided in organized batches rather than as isolated one-off videos.



The monthly workload may include a mix of:



* Short-form videos

* Simple edits

* Alternate versions of the same source footage

* Testimonial edits

* Educational videos

* Mid-length videos

* Occasional longer-form pieces

* Thumbnails



The mix and volume of work may vary slightly from month to month within the agreed scope.



The agreed monthly flat rate covers the regular editing workload established between Hot Tanks and the selected editor.



One consolidated revision round per assignment is normally expected.



## What Hot Tanks Provides



Hot Tanks will provide:



* Raw footage

* Content direction

* Required dimensions

* Brand assets

* Reference examples when needed

* Required text, labels, or end frames

* Editing instructions

* Consolidated feedback



The editor is not expected to independently create the overall content strategy.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person should have:



* Strong short-form video editing skills.

* Good pacing and storytelling judgement.

* Experience editing vertical and horizontal video.

* Experience preparing social-media-ready content.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Reliable file organization.

* Strong written English for captions and on-screen text.

* Ability to follow templates, instructions, and standards consistently.

* Ability to receive feedback and apply it without repeatedly making the same corrections.

* Reliable communication.

* Reliable turnaround.

* Good judgement about when to cut and when to let a moment breathe.



Experience with home services, trades, testimonials, educational content, or local-business marketing is helpful but not required.



## Software



You may use professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Similar professional editing software



We care more about the quality and consistency of the finished work than the specific software used.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful Video Editor:



* Learns the Hot Tanks editing style.

* Delivers clean, publication-ready videos.

* Requires fewer corrections over time.

* Keeps branding consistent.

* Meets agreed deadlines.

* Keeps files organized.

* Communicates clearly.

* Handles repeatable monthly production reliably.

* Turns raw footage into useful finished assets the Hot Tanks TEAM can publish confidently.



## Compensation



**Monthly Compensation Range: $500–$1,000 CAD**



This is an ongoing freelance/contract editing role.



The final monthly rate will be agreed upon based on:



* Experience

* Editing quality

* Efficiency

* Ability to follow the Hot Tanks editing standard

* Communication and reliability

* Agreed monthly workload



We are looking for a flat monthly arrangement that reflects the agreed workload rather than pricing every individual video separately.



## Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test editing project using actual Hot Tanks footage.



The purpose of the test is to allow both Hot Tanks and the editor to determine whether the working relationship is a good fit before entering into an ongoing monthly arrangement.



The paid test will evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Pacing and storytelling

* Ability to follow instructions

* Brand consistency

* Caption and on-screen text accuracy

* Attention to detail

* Communication

* Turnaround time and reliability

* Ability to apply feedback



The test project will be compensated at an agreed project rate before the work begins.



Completion of the paid test does not guarantee an ongoing contract. Candidates whose work is a strong fit may be offered the monthly freelance editing role.



This role is focused on turning approved Hot Tanks footage into strong, consistent, publication-ready video content.

I need someone who can learn how my business works, stay on top of projects and clients, notice what needs attention, follow up without being reminded, and help keep everything moving while I focus on creative direction, production, sales, and growing the company.



If you’re calm, proactive, extremely organized, resourceful, and an excellent communicator, you’ll thrive here.



Your Responsibilities



Executive / Administrative

* Help manage inbox and important follow-ups

* Keep my daily and weekly priorities organized

* Research vendors, services, travel, crew, etc.

Clients & Projects

Marketing & Business Development

Who I’m Looking For

* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Proactive — you don’t wait to be told everything

* Strong professional communication

* Comfortable communicating with clients

* Resourceful and good at figuring things out

* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

Big Plus If You Have Experience With

You do not need to be an expert in everything above. I’m looking more for intelligence, initiative, communication, organization and willingness to learn.



Hours



Starting part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase hours and potentially become full-time if it’s a great fit and the workload supports it.



Hours & Work Style



Starting part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger/full-time role.



I care much more about productivity and results than watching a clock. I’m not looking for someone to sit online for a certain number of hours just to log time. If you’re organized, efficient, and get your responsibilities handled properly, that’s what matters to me.



I value ownership, communication, and results over hours worked. The goal is to make sure clients are taken care of, projects keep moving, content gets posted, follow-ups happen, and important tasks don’t fall through the cracks.



I want someone who works efficiently and eventually understands the business well enough to know what needs to happen without constantly waiting for instructions.





How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your VA/executive assistant experience

3. Any client/account management experience

title: Data & Reporting Specialist – Shopify Dropshipping (Detail-Oriented, Proactive)
description:
Dear applicant,



We run a growing Shopify dropshipping operation and are scaling hard this year. We are looking for a Data & Reporting Specialist to join a new team.



This is **not** a copy-paste data entry role. You will be the person who checks whether our numbers are correct, notices when something looks wrong, and tells us before it becomes a problem. If a number in the sheet doesn't make sense, we expect you to flag it — not to enter it and move on.



You must be able to think for yourself and communicate clearly. To show you read this post carefully, start your reply with the word **strawberry** before you introduce yourself.



**Please answer these questions in your application:**



1. Which of these have you worked with, and for how long: Shopify,
 Ads Manager, Slack, Incogniton, Google Sheets?

2. Describe a time you spotted an error in data someone else produced. What did you do?

3. In a Google Sheet with daily ad spend and revenue per product, which numbers would you check first to see if something is off? Why?

4. What do you do when the workflow tells you one thing, but the data clearly says something else?

5. Are you available 4–10 hours a day, 7 days a week? Which hours (state your timezone)?

6. What internet speed and backup connection do you have?



**Requirements:**



- Experience with
 Ads Manager (must)

- Experience with Shopify (must)

- Strong written English and proactive communication (must)

- Comfortable following written workflows and video training (must)

- Confident in Google Sheets — filtering, cross-checking, spotting inconsistencies

- Able to read data and explain what it means, not just record it

- Experience with Slack

- Experience with Incogniton is a plus



If you do not meet these requirements, please do not apply — thank you.



**Your responsibilities:**



- Recording daily KPIs accurately and on time

- **Verifying** the data: cross-checking numbers, catching mistakes, missing entries and outliers

- **Reporting proactively**: a short daily update on what you saw, what changed, and anything that looks wrong

- Raising delays or blockers immediately instead of waiting to be asked

- Coordinating with team members in the same process

- Working according to our strategy, workflows and schedule



We provide full workflows and video training for every step of the process. We offer real career growth for team members who take ownership.



If this sounds like you, apply with your answers to the questions above.



Best regards,



TWK

title: # Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades
description:
# Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades



**Part-Time | Remote | UK Company | Approx. 2 Days per Week Initially**



We are a UK-based company supplying skilled technical personnel for projects aboard **cruise ships, superyachts, commercial vessels and within shipyards/dry docks**.



We are looking for an experienced **Technical Recruiter** to join us on a part-time, remote basis. The successful candidate will initially work approximately **2 days per week**, with the potential for the role and hours to expand for the right person.



## The Role



Your primary responsibility will be to review, screen and shortlist skilled tradespeople for marine and shipyard projects, ensuring candidates have the appropriate technical experience, qualifications and certifications before being selected for testing and potential mobilisation.



You will recruit across technical trades including:



* Welders / coded welders

* Pipefitters and fabricators

* Mechanical fitters / technicians

* Electricians

* Plumbers

* HVAC and related mechanical trades

* Other skilled marine and shipyard personnel



## Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing incoming CVs and applications

* Conducting initial candidate screening and telephone/video interviews

* Assessing candidates' technical experience and suitability for specific projects

* Reviewing welding qualifications, coding/certification and relevant trade credentials

* Understanding the difference between candidates suitable for shipyard/dry-dock work and those suitable for mobilisation aboard operational vessels

* Checking candidates' marine documentation and certification where required

* Identifying candidates who should progress to practical trade/welding testing

* Shortlisting and recommending suitable personnel to management

* Maintaining accurate candidate records and recruitment pipelines

* Communicating with candidates regarding documentation, testing, availability and potential mobilisation

* Helping develop and maintain a reliable pool of qualified technical personnel for future projects



## Technical Knowledge Required



NOTE This is **not a general recruitment or virtual assistant position**. We are specifically looking for someone who understands technical trades and can confidently assess whether a candidate's experience and qualifications are relevant.



You should have good working knowledge of several of the following areas:



**Welding & Fabrication**

Understanding of welding processes and terminology such as TIG/GTAW, MIG/MAG/GMAW, SMAW/MMA, FCAW, welding positions, materials and coded/qualified welders.



You should be comfortable reviewing welding qualifications and understanding whether a candidate's certification and experience are appropriate for the work being considered.



**Mechanical / Electrical / Plumbing**

Ability to understand CVs from mechanical fitters, pipefitters, electricians, plumbers and similar technical personnel and distinguish genuine relevant experience from general construction experience.



**Marine / Shipyard Recruitment**

Ideally, you will understand the documentation and certification that can be required when personnel work aboard vessels, cruise ships, yachts or within shipyards/dry docks.



Experience dealing with areas such as STCW certification, seafarer medicals, passports/visas, seaman's books and vessel-specific requirements would be highly advantageous.



You do not need to be a welder or engineer yourself, but you **must be technically confident enough to screen experienced tradespeople and ask the right questions**.



## Ideal Candidate



We would particularly like to hear from candidates who have previously worked in:



* Marine or maritime recruitment

* Shipyard recruitment

* Oil & gas / offshore recruitment

* Engineering recruitment

* Skilled trades recruitment

* Welding/fabrication recruitment

* Technical manpower or crewing agencies



Previous experience recruiting Filipino skilled tradespeople for international projects would be a significant advantage.



## Working Arrangement



* Fully remote position

* Working for a UK-based company

* Initially approximately **2 days per week**. Starting next month. 

* Potential to increase hours/responsibilities for the right candidate

* Some availability during UK working hours will be required

* Hourly rate: Negotiable depending on experience**



We are more interested in finding someone with the **right technical knowledge and recruitment experience** than simply selecting the lowest hourly rate.



## How to Apply



Please send your CV together with Linkedin page and a short introduction explaining your relevant recruitment experience.



In your application, please specifically answer the following:



1. What experience do you have recruiting welders, mechanical trades or other skilled technical personnel?

2. Have you recruited personnel for marine, shipyard, offshore or vessel-based work?

3. What welding qualifications/certifications are you familiar with?

4. What documentation or certification would you normally check before mobilising a tradesperson to work aboard a vessel?

5. Which technical trades are you most experienced in recruiting?

6. What hourly rate are you seeking?

7. Are you available approximately 2 days per week initially?



Applications that do not address these questions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our recruitment process and, for the right candidate, there is potential for the position to develop into a larger ongoing role.
